# Migration workbench — operator guide

The workbench brings original file-share inventories, Migration Manager reports, reviewed mappings, item evidence and correction decisions into one editable project. It includes a local browser interface, streaming original-file intake, SQLite reconciliation, readable review reports, complete finding exports and an independently reopenable delivery.

It extends the original migration audit in this directory. The original audit.mjs and audit.test.mjs keep their existing strict input contract. Use the operating workbench when real reports contain partial, missing or unknown fields.

## Current navigation and case workflow

Sources, Rounds, Mappings & evidence, Reconciliation, Corrections and Handover & history retain the original file-evidence workflow below. **Cases & cutover** adds six views in the same project: Source mappings, Destination plans, Rehearsals, Finding decisions, Cutover and All case records.

For a case migration, import the actual originals in Sources, review the complete field projections, select explicit source editions and cutoff/status policy, reconcile independent target inventories separately from loader receipts, then record finding responses and cutover tasks. [CASE_MIGRATION.md](CASE_MIGRATION.md) gives the full operator sequence, request shapes, exports and customer-return steps. [CASE_RECEIVING.md](CASE_RECEIVING.md) describes the complete actual-input native programme.

Expand the Cases working-file panel to download or restore complete form drafts and original pending commands. These browser drafts are separate from accepted SQLite records. A conflicting tab preserves its own downloadable work; load the selected saved edition explicitly.

## Typed registers, financial reporting and property continuity

**Registers** adds reviewed typed field mappings, original source/target populations, explicit relationship and financial-control selections, two-edition comparison, finding decisions and attributed cutover review. It uses this same project's source intake and original request history. [REGISTER_OPERATOR.md](REGISTER_OPERATOR.md) explains the complete interface; [REGISTER_MIGRATION.md](REGISTER_MIGRATION.md) gives its domain contract.

Each register retains exact textual identity components and explicitly selected text, decimal, date, datetime, boolean or JSON fields. Signed measures stay separated by their selected currency/unit and period groups. Inspect population coverage and original source occurrences when interpreting a finding. A missing target inventory remains visible as unresolved evidence, including when it contains no observed rows.

Expand the Registers working-file panel to download or restore unsubmitted forms and pending original operations. [REGISTER_RECEIVING.md](REGISTER_RECEIVING.md) covers complete CSV/NDJSON exports, readable reports, editable producer/customer returns and the authored seven-register programme.

The header also links to the maintained [financial reporting](FINANCIAL_REPORTING.md) and [property continuity](PROPERTY_CONTINUITY.md) applications. The header also opens [CRF reporting and workbook return](CRF_REPORTING.md): six reviewed source families, interim/cumulative annual editions, complete differences, retained finding decisions, actual workbook bindings and complete portable receiving. All workflows preserve their original editions in the same SQLite workspace. [Housing commissioning](HOUSING_COMMISSIONING.md) connects Registers, Property and Financial reporting for one complete transition, including two recipient operators' continued work. The complete handover includes readable property and financial reports with every original record and full CSV/NDJSON sections.

## Open an operating workspace

Use Linux with Python 3.10 or later. The operating application uses the Python standard library. Node is only needed to run the existing standalone audit.

From this complete application directory:

    python migration_server.py \
      --workspace "/absolute/path/to/migration-workspace" \
      --create \
      --title "File migration operating workspace"

Open http://127.0.0.1:8083 in the browser. Enter the operator name that should be recorded with changes. To reopen the same project later, use the same command without --create. The server prints the actual local address and original workspace identity.

One process owns a workspace at a time. Stop its existing server before opening that same directory through the CLI. A separate received workspace has its own directory and can be opened independently. Keep application and workspace paths as ordinary directories.

The default listener is local to this machine. The --host and --port flags support an explicitly managed deployment. The supplied server has no account-management layer; any remote deployment must use the project's normal network access controls.

## 1. Retain the source and review its declared meaning

In Sources, choose the complete input file and select **Retain file & preview**. Intake streams the original bytes to the workspace; it does not load an entire large source in a browser JSON field.

Choose the actual report format, source role, scope and identity namespace. Every source also declares capture kind and coverage. Customer exports, public reference material and local product reference records remain distinct.

The scope identifies the migration cohort. The identity namespace identifies the system in which item IDs have the same meaning. A source inventory and a target inventory can share source IDs only when the operator has explicitly established that namespace relationship.

Declare complete, partial, failure-only or unknown coverage and explain it. An optional expected original-row count is checked against the imported row count. It is separate from a report's scanned, expected-to-migrate or migrated count.

Keep task, migration-job, report-set, snapshot, package, device and incremental-round identities where their original source provides them. The importer retains original row values and any separate context. A context conflict remains visible.

The header preview supports comma, semicolon, tab and pipe delimiters, plus declared UTF-8/UTF-16 variants. Changing encoding or delimiter refreshes the preview. It only previews headers and a few rows; import parses the full retained original file.

### Supported inputs

| Source family | Interpretation |
| --- | --- |
| Migration Manager ItemReport | Original attempted-item observations and reported status vocabulary |
| ItemFailureReport | Original failure subset |
| ItemSummary, TaskSummary and ScanSummary | Original pipeline and population counts with distinct denominators |
| Structure report and its two failure families | Original structure operations and failures |
| Inventory JSONL or CSV | Explicit source or target inventory with nullable fields |
| Purview CSV | Explicitly mapped classification evidence with declared scan/cycle/coverage |
| Microsoft custom user mapping CSV | Exact headerless source principal, destination UPN and TRUE/FALSE AD-group flag |
| Identity, status or evidence mapping JSONL | Original entries for a reviewed mapping edition |
| Attachment | Original supporting bytes retained without a derived tenant conclusion |

Generic inventory and Purview CSV require a reviewed canonical-field-to-exact-header map. Provider reports preserve documented spelling and case. Use the provider-heading mapping only for a reviewed locale or producer variant, with a mapping note.

Missing column, blank value, explicit JSON null, invalid value and zero remain different. Row issues and original locations are available through **Inspect & copy IDs**. Complete original bytes remain downloadable.

Microsoft's documented ItemReport and ItemFailureReport headings differ. In particular, File name/File size/Incremental round are not silently substituted for Item name/Item size/Incremental Round. A report's Source and Destination locations are not treated as full item paths without separate explicit evidence.

Sources:
- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepointmigration/mm-reports
- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepointmigration/mm-user-mapping-file
- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepointmigration/mm-settings
- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/deploy-scanner-manage

## 2. Select an exact migration round

In Rounds, select the baseline source inventory and the precise target/report captures to review together. Give the round its title, scope and label. A later round can name its predecessor.

When a source file contains multiple tasks, jobs or rounds, supply exact per-source selectors. Several selectors may refer to different parts of the same source. Selected original occurrences remain distinct. The workbench does not choose a latest result or silently deduplicate repeated source IDs.

The recent source list is a shortcut. Enter any exact retained source ID in the additional-ID field, or use **All records** to search the complete paged catalogue.

## 3. Review identity, principal, status and evidence mappings

Mappings & evidence creates immutable reviewed editions. Each edition can use an exact imported mapping source or manual entries.

- **Identity:** link an exact source occurrence to an exact target occurrence with a reason. Ambiguous or conflicting relationships remain review findings.
- **Principal:** preserve the declared source/destination principal and AD-group flag. Record the selected Entra fallback setting. Matching a principal declaration does not prove effective access, group expansion or inheritance.
- **Status:** classify actual provider vocabulary as reported success, failure, filtered or in progress. The original text stays available; a reported-success classification does not fill in missing target fields.
- **Evidence:** link a subject occurrence to a precise evidence occurrence and select the fields it supplies. A reviewed evidence mapping can contain the complete imported evidence collection; an individual evidence link is useful for a single review.

Inspect original rows before assigning IDs. Evidence is joined by an explicit reviewed relationship, rather than a guessed path/date match. An evidence row must belong to the selected round. Browse the complete mapping entries with the paged controls.

The default reconciliation uses target inventory as its observation basis. Select the attempted-item report basis deliberately when that is the evidence being reviewed. Mixing an independent target inventory and attempted-item report into one implicit target population would create misleading duplicates.

## 4. Reconcile and interpret field coverage

Create a reconciliation from the selected round. Choose shared-source-ID identity with its reason, or a reviewed exact-occurrence mapping. Bind the intended principal, status and evidence mapping editions and any individual evidence links. Choose the field checks required for this review.

| Result | Operating meaning |
| --- | --- |
| MATCH | Selected supplied evidence agrees for the evaluated checks |
| DIFFERENT | A selected field has a recorded difference |
| UNKNOWN | A required value, relationship or coverage conclusion is not established |
| AMBIGUOUS | The selected original occurrences or mappings do not resolve one relationship |
| MISSING | An expected item is absent from an explicitly complete selected target inventory for the same scope and namespace |
| UNEXPECTED | An actual selected target-inventory occurrence has no selected expected counterpart |

An unpaired migration-report observation cannot establish unexpected target presence. Failure-only reports cannot establish target absence or success. Purview policy-only and incremental captures retain their more limited effective coverage even when an operator's declared coverage says complete.

The review report shows declared and effective source coverage together. It also separates selected baseline occurrences, selected observation occurrences, explicitly linked pairs and each field's actual result counts. Known byte sums are labeled occurrence-based declared quantities; unknown sizes are counted separately.

For complete item details, use **Field evidence**. It retains original expected/observed values, presence states, mapping bases and source-row references. Use the exact finding ID to open a correction.

A report-file SHA identifies the retained report bytes. A content comparison requires explicitly supplied content hashes bound to the same item. Principal declarations, label values, classification timestamps, effective access and policy enforcement remain separate evidence questions.

## 5. Work the correction queue

Open a correction against the exact reconciliation and item. Give it a useful title, owner or unassigned state, note and supporting occurrence IDs.

Record progress, a request for evidence, resolution, accepted variance or withdrawal. Each decision appends to the original history and records the operator.

Resolution requires a later MATCH for the same retained baseline occurrence. Create a successor target capture/round/reconciliation and select its exact matching finding. An accepted variance records an operator decision and keeps the original field difference intact.

Correction history can be inspected in the browser and exported through the original CLI. **All records** searches the complete current projection; recent lists do not limit retained history.

## 6. Prepare a complete delivery

Handover & history prepares the full editable project at the selected revision. The operation freezes the database, full application and readable report under the same workspace owner mutex before reserving its export action. The sender records export reservation/completion afterward. The receiving project starts from the selected captured revision.

The ZIP contains:

- the complete application, original audit, Python core, HTTP interface, browser assets and guides;
- the original SQLite workspace snapshot, including source interpretations, rounds, mappings, findings, decisions, case datasets/plans/rehearsals/reviews/cutovers, complete case rows and operation history;
- every original object in that snapshot's file table, including retained inputs that have not yet been imported;
- every earlier completed delivery archive that the snapshot's delivery records reference;
- reports/review.html, a readable review of selected populations, coverage, reconciliation runs and current correction decisions;
- complete per-reconciliation CSV and NDJSON finding tables, plus machine-readable catalogues;
- reports/case-review.html, all five case descriptor inventories and complete selected descriptor/row exports for each case edition.

Current deliveries bind all 59 application files under commons.migration-workbench-application/v6. Complete earlier 16-, 21-, 24-, 31-, 39-, 48- and 56-file deliveries and preparations already frozen to their respective rosters retain their original application identity. See the portable contract in [CASE_MIGRATION.md](CASE_MIGRATION.md).

The readable report is an offline document and can be printed from a browser. It contains no external scripts, fonts or tracking. The full original decision history remains in SQLite even where a readable recent-history projection is shorter.

All exported counts, original IDs and numeric precision remain available in machine-readable records. CSV exports quote every field and keep user-supplied path/name values inside an exact JSON record column; the separate flat columns contain engine-owned IDs and status codes.

Earlier complete native ZIPs are retained because their recorded download links must keep working after receiving. Consequently, deliveries with substantial delivery history can be larger than a current-state-only export. No completed original archive is silently retired.

## 7. Receive and continue editing

Use the original receiver:

    python migration_portable.py receive \
      --archive "/absolute/path/to/Migration_Workbench_delivery.zip" \
      --destination "/absolute/path/to/received-migration"

Or use the same receiver through the operating CLI:

    python migration_cli.py receive "/absolute/path/to/Migration_Workbench_delivery.zip" \
      --into "/absolute/path/to/received-migration" \
      --sha256 "the recorded complete archive SHA256" \
      --bytes 123456

Replace the example byte count and SHA with the actual delivery record. Neither is a template value to submit unchanged.

Receiving verifies the full manifest and every archive member, then checks that the SQLite snapshot's original object and earlier-delivery inventory exactly equals the archive's workspace closure. Its database identity is verified before the first store open.

A durable receiving marker precedes restoration, and a separate verified-database marker precedes SQLite's first journal transition. An interrupted receiver can continue the same destination. It preserves failed original prefixes. Only a complete independently verified duplicate of a successfully published local file is retired.

Start the received application:

    python "/absolute/path/to/received-migration/application/migration_server.py" \
      --workspace "/absolute/path/to/received-migration/workspace"

Open the printed local address. Continue the original project by recording a receiving review note and assignment on an appropriate correction through the CLI or browser.

Repeating receive after READY rechecks the immutable application, original objects, reports and historical ZIPs, then reopens the same workspace identity. It preserves later editable database changes. It does not reset a received project back to the publication revision.

## 8. Resume an interrupted local operation

A submitted HTTP request can finish even if the browser loses its response. The browser retains the original command ID for that tab. In Handover & history, inspect the original operation before choosing its continuation.

A completed exact request returns its recorded result. Reusing an operation ID with changed semantic input is rejected. A revision conflict refreshes the current revision and preserves the form for review.

For an interrupted operation, choose the original operation ID and give the reason for continuation. The original source bytes, selected round/mappings, parser/engine version and request remain bound. A delivery continuation uses the captured application and database, including when the current deployment has since changed.

If an application capture stopped before copying every originally selected source file, the remaining bytes must still match the retained original inventory. The operation retains its partial capture and does not silently substitute a new deployment.

## Case API and complete exports

The case module uses the same POST /api/operations envelope and POST /api/read transport as the existing workbench. Its five create operations are case.dataset.create, case.plan.create, case.rehearsal.create, case.review.create and case.cutover.create. Read case.schema for the installed fields; use case.list/get and the original paged row/item/compare readers for complete history.

For full files, GET /api/exports?kind=case.rehearsal&id=ACTUAL_ID&format=csv (or ndjson) streams the exact selected complete descriptor plus all original result records. The five export kinds are case.dataset, case.plan, case.rehearsal, case.review and case.cutover. The server completes the selected stream under the original workspace mutex before sending the response length.

The native CLI exposes the same full export and a revision-bound report command. Its case schema/list/get/preview/create commands are documented in [CASE_MIGRATION.md](CASE_MIGRATION.md). New mutations always use a current state revision; an old successful request's replay returns its original result revision.

## Operating limits and verification

Whole input files and result exports are streamed. SQLite stores indexed original occurrences and findings. Browser row/result pages are bounded, while the full catalogue and full exports remain available. The maximum command JSON is 2 MiB; bulk records use streamed file intake. A single parsed original row is limited to 8 MiB. Numeric expansion also has a digit bound before formatting.

The local interface uses neutral grayscale, labeled controls, semantic tables, visible keyboard focus, live operation status and responsive reflow. These are implementation choices. Record actual automated/manual accessibility checks and their results for the intended deployment and assistive-technology environment.

The Commonwealth's published vendor obligations describe accessibility acceptance separately from this source implementation:
https://www.mass.gov/info-details/vendor-digital-accessibility-testing-obligations

Native integration should exercise one complete operating journey: actual source intake, mapping review, first-round findings, correction, successor reconciliation, complete publication, separate receiving, later editable change and repeat receiving with that edit preserved. A local product reference journey identifies its data as local_reference; a public source document is public_reference. Neither is presented as a customer migration result.

MIGRATION_CORE.md documents the exact original API, source profiles, normalization and operation semantics. This guide describes how an operator uses the complete workbench.

A complete local operating application for source inventories, file migration evidence, case/document relationships, typed registers, exact financial controls, property continuity, independent rehearsal results, reviewed findings and portable customer continuation. #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Receive the complete case migration workflow on supplied original workspaces and files."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import sys

from migration_store import MigrationError, canonical, identity, identifier, file_hash, parse_json, regular
from migration_workspace import MigrationWorkspace
from migration_cli import _file_path, _publish, _binary_chunks, _stage
from migration_portable import (APPLICATION_FILES, ordinary_directory, publish_bytes,
    canonical as encoded, inspect_delivery, receive_delivery, PortableService, digest, sync_parent, member_name)
from migration_reports import build_reports, case_pages, case_records

SCHEMA = "commons.case-migration-receiving/v1"
PHASES = ("01-original-input", "02-original-case-actions", "03-complete-reports",
          "04-producer-delivery", "05-customer-receive", "06-customer-actions",
          "07-older-receiving-replay", "08-customer-return", "09-return-reopen",
          "10-original-request-replay")
INPUT_LIMIT = 16 * 1024 * 1024
RECEIPT_LIMIT = 96 * 1024 * 1024
SOURCE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE_KINDS = ("dataset", "plan", "rehearsal", "review", "cutover")
ALLOWED = {"source.import", "case.dataset.create", "case.plan.create",
           "case.rehearsal.create", "case.review.create", "case.cutover.create",
           "workspace.update"}


def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise MigrationError("CASE_RECEIVING", message)


def json_file(path, limit=RECEIPT_LIMIT):
    actual = _file_path(path)
    with actual.open("rb") as stream:
        raw = stream.read(limit + 1)
    need(len(raw) <= limit, "The complete selected JSON exceeds its documented input bound")
    return raw, parse_json(raw.decode("utf-8"))


def pointer(value, selected):
    need(isinstance(selected, str) and (selected == "" or selected.startswith("/")),
         "Use an explicit JSON pointer into the original accepted result")
    for part in selected.split("/")[1:]:
        part = part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            need(part in value, "The selected original result field is absent")
            value = value[part]
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            need(part.isdecimal() and (part == "0" or not part.startswith("0")),
                 "Use an exact original result array index")
            index = int(part)
            need(index < len(value), "The selected original result index is absent")
            value = value[index]
        else:
            raise MigrationError("CASE_RECEIVING", "Cannot traverse the selected original result")
    return value


class Receiving:
    schema = SCHEMA
    phases = PHASES
    kinds = CASE_KINDS
    allowed = ALLOWED
    domain = "case"
    catalog_key = "case_entities"
    records = staticmethod(case_records)
    lanes = (("producer", "steps"), ("customer", "customer_steps"))
    delivery_lanes = ("producer", "customer")
    meaning = "Supplied original case workflow, retained decisions and portable customer continuation; no tenant write or inferred approval."
    def __init__(self, source_input, out):
        self.out = ordinary_directory(out, create=True)
        need(not (self.out.stat().st_mode & 0o077), "Keep the receiving directory private")
        self.lock = os.open(self.out / "operation.lock", os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
        info = os.fstat(self.lock)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and not info.st_mode & 0o077,
             "Keep an ordinary private operation lock")
        fcntl.flock(self.lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        self.owned = []
        self.results = {}
        self.files = {}
        self.artifacts = {}
        self.action_receipts = []
        self.stage_receipts = []
        self.raw, self.input = json_file(source_input, INPUT_LIMIT)
        value = self.input
        need(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("schema") == self.schema, "Select the complete receiving input")
        self.configure_input(value)
        self.operation_id = identifier(value.get("operation_id"))
        need(len(self.operation_id) <= 80, "Keep the original receiving ID within 80 characters")
        operation_ids, source_keys = set(), set()
        for lane, field in self.lanes:
            need(isinstance(value.get(field), list) and value[field], "Supply complete original " + field)
            keys = set()
            for step in value[field]:
                need(isinstance(step, dict), "Select complete original action objects")
                key, operation_id = identifier(step.get("key")), identifier(step.get("operation_id"))
                need(key not in keys and operation_id not in operation_ids and len(operation_id) <= 100,
                     "Keep action keys distinct per lane and original operation IDs distinct within 100 characters")
                need(step.get("operation") in self.allowed and isinstance(step.get("payload"), dict),
                     "Select the actual complete case/source action")
                keys.add(key)
                operation_ids.add(operation_id)
        reserved = {self.operation_id + "-" + lane + "-delivery" for lane in self.delivery_lanes}
        controls = {item + "-continue" for item in operation_ids | reserved}
        need(not (operation_ids & (reserved | controls)), "Original action and continuation identities overlap")
        need(isinstance(value.get("source_files", []), list), "Select complete original source files")
        for item in value.get("source_files", []):
            need(isinstance(item, dict), "Select a complete source-file receipt")
            key = identifier(item.get("key"))
            need(key not in source_keys, "Keep every original source-file key distinct")
            source_keys.add(key)
        self.validate_comparison_input(value)
        need(isinstance(value.get("authorization"), str) and value["authorization"].strip(),
             "Retain the actual authority for this original case operation")
        need(isinstance(value.get("actor"), str) and value["actor"].strip(), "Select the recorded operator")
        self.input_sha = hashlib.sha256(self.raw).hexdigest()
        self.put("original-input.json", self.raw)
        source_selection = []
        for name in APPLICATION_FILES:
            path = SOURCE_ROOT / name
            regular(path)
            source_selection.append({"path": name, **file_hash(path)})
        wanted = value.get("application")
        need(isinstance(wanted, list) and wanted == source_selection,
             "Select every complete current application body before the original case is opened")
        runtime = Path(sys.executable).resolve()
        selection = {"schema": self.schema + "/selection", "operation_id": self.operation_id,
                     "input_sha256": self.input_sha, "application": source_selection,
                     "runtime": {"path": str(runtime), "version": sys.version, **file_hash(runtime)}}
        self.put("selection.json", encoded(selection))
        self.selection = selection

    def configure_input(self, value):
        """Additive receivers may select existing modules before action admission."""

    def validate_comparison_input(self, value):
        comparison = value.get("comparison")
        need(isinstance(comparison, dict) and set(comparison) == {"before_id", "after_id"},
             "Select both actual rehearsal editions for the complete correction comparison")

    def actor_for_lane(self, lane):
        return self.input["actor"]

    def get_record(self, workspace, kind, entity_id):
        return workspace.dispatch(self.domain + "." + kind + ".get", {"id":entity_id})

    def export_kind(self, kind):
        return self.domain + "." + kind

    def continue_original(self, workspace, folder, operation_id, actor, reason):
        """False preserves the original case/register continuation control."""
        return False

    def put(self, relative, data):
        relative = member_name(relative)
        need(not relative.endswith(".json") or len(data) <= RECEIPT_LIMIT,
             "Keep each complete retained JSON receipt within the documented 96 MiB bound")
        path = self.out / relative
        need(path.is_relative_to(self.out), "Retain artifacts inside the original operation")
        ordinary_directory(path.parent, create=True)
        publish_bytes(path, data)
        receipt = {"path": relative, **file_hash(path)}
        self.artifacts[relative] = receipt
        return receipt

    def remember(self, path):
        path = Path(path)
        relative = path.relative_to(self.out).as_posix()
        ordinary_directory(path.parent)
        regular(path)
        receipt = {"path": relative, **file_hash(path)}
        sync_parent(path)
        self.artifacts[relative] = receipt
        return receipt

    def verify(self, receipt):
        path = self.out / member_name(receipt["path"])
        need(path.is_relative_to(self.out), "Retained artifact path escaped the original output")
        regular(path)
        need(file_hash(path) == {key:receipt[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")},
             "A complete retained artifact differs: " + receipt["path"])
        need(self.remember(path) == receipt, "The original artifact changed during exact adoption")

    def open(self, path):
        workspace = MigrationWorkspace.__new__(MigrationWorkspace)
        self.owned.append(workspace)
        workspace.__init__(path, create=False)
        return workspace

    def close(self, workspace):
        workspace.close()
        self.owned.remove(workspace)

    def close_all(self):
        errors = []
        for workspace in list(reversed(self.owned)):
            try:
                self.close(workspace)
            except BaseException as error:
                errors.append(str(error))
        if errors:
            raise MigrationError("CASE_RECEIVING_CLOSE", "Original workspace closure is unresolved", {"errors": errors})

    def resolve(self, value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            if set(value) == {"$result", "pointer"}:
                need(value["$result"] in self.results, "Select an already accepted original action")
                return pointer(self.results[value["$result"]], value["pointer"])
            if set(value) == {"$file", "field"}:
                need(value["$file"] in self.files, "Select a retained complete original source")
                need(value["field"] in ("sha256", "bytes", "filename"), "Select an original file identity field")
                return self.files[value["$file"]][value["field"]]
            return {key:self.resolve(item) for key,item in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [self.resolve(item) for item in value]
        return value

    def action(self, workspace, step, lane):
        need(isinstance(step, dict), "Use a complete original action")
        key = identifier(step.get("key"))
        operation = step.get("operation")
        need(operation in self.allowed, "Use one advertised case/source operation")
        operation_id = identifier(step.get("operation_id"))
        actor = step.get("actor", self.actor_for_lane(lane))
        payload = self.resolve(step.get("payload"))
        need(isinstance(payload, dict) and not (set(payload) & {"operation_id", "actor", "expected_revision"}),
             "Keep the original operation envelope separate from the supplied action fields")
        folder = "actions/" + lane + "/" + key
        request_path = self.out / folder / "request.json"
        semantic = {"operation": operation, "payload": {**payload, "actor": actor}}
        semantic_sha = identity(semantic)
        if request_path.exists():
            _, saved = json_file(request_path)
            request = saved["request"]
            need(saved["workspace_id"] == workspace.project["id"] and saved["operation"] == operation and
                 request["operation_id"] == operation_id and
                 identity({"operation": operation, "payload": {k:v for k,v in request.items()
                     if k not in ("operation_id", "expected_revision")}}) == semantic_sha,
                 "The original action request or selected workspace changed")
        else:
            request = {**payload, "operation_id": operation_id, "actor": actor,
                       "expected_revision": workspace.project["revision"]}
            self.put(folder + "/request.json", encoded({"operation": operation,
                "workspace_id":workspace.project["id"], "request": request}))
        self.remember(request_path)
        before = workspace.dispatch("operation.get", {"id": operation_id})
        if before["found"]:
            original = before["operation"]
            need(original["operation"] == operation and original["request_sha256"] == semantic_sha,
                 "The selected original operation has another request")
            if original["status"] != "SUCCEEDED":
                # Continuing an incomplete native operation needs the operator's
                # explicit original reason, retained as its own control request.
                reason = step.get("resume_reason")
                need(isinstance(reason, str) and reason.strip(),
                     "Retain the original interrupted operation; use its predeclared resume_reason or resume it through the original CLI")
                if not self.continue_original(workspace, folder, operation_id, actor, reason):
                    control = {"target_operation_id":operation_id, "reason":reason,
                               "operation_id":operation_id + "-continue", "actor":actor,
                               "expected_revision":workspace.project["revision"]}
                    control_path = self.out / folder / "resume-control.json"
                    if control_path.exists():
                        _, prior_control = json_file(control_path)
                        need(prior_control["target_operation_id"] == operation_id and
                             prior_control["reason"] == reason and prior_control["actor"] == actor,
                             "The original continuation reason changed")
                        control = prior_control
                    self.put(folder + "/resume-control.json", encoded(control))
                    workspace.dispatch("operation.resume", control)
        try:
            returned = workspace.dispatch(operation, request)
        except BaseException as error:
            observed = workspace.dispatch("operation.get", {"id": operation_id})
            self.put(folder + "/observed-" + identity(observed) + ".json", encoded(observed))
            raise
        original = workspace.dispatch("operation.get", {"id": operation_id})["operation"]
        need(original["status"] == "SUCCEEDED" and original["request_sha256"] == semantic_sha,
             "The original operation did not reach its recorded complete result")
        # Reused is transport state. Acceptance binds the original stored result,
        # not a later replay's reused flag or current workspace revision.
        accepted = {"operation": operation, "operation_id":operation_id,
                    "workspace_id":workspace.project["id"], "request_sha256":semantic_sha,
                    "original_result":original["result"], "key":key, "lane":lane}
        self.put(folder + "/accepted.json", encoded(accepted))
        self.accept_action(accepted)
        return original["result"]["result"]

    def stage(self, name, callback):
        selected = self.out / "phases" / (name + ".json")
        if selected.exists():
            _, receipt = json_file(selected)
            need(receipt["schema"] == self.schema + "/phase" and receipt["phase"] == name and
                 receipt["input_sha256"] == self.input_sha, "Original completed phase changed")
            for artifact in receipt["artifacts"]:
                self.verify(artifact)
            self.remember(selected)
            self.stage_receipts.append(receipt)
            return receipt["result"]
        result = callback()
        receipt = {"schema":self.schema + "/phase", "phase":name, "input_sha256":self.input_sha,
                   "result":result, "artifacts":list(self.artifacts.values())}
        self.put("phases/" + name + ".json", encoded(receipt))
        self.stage_receipts.append(receipt)
        return result

    def stage_files(self, workspace):
        results = []
        for item in self.input.get("source_files", []):
            key = identifier(item.get("key"))
            need(key not in self.files, "Every selected source key must be unique")
            need(isinstance(item.get("bytes"), int) and not isinstance(item["bytes"], bool) and item["bytes"] >= 0,
                 "Select the complete original source byte length")
            need(isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str) and len(item["sha256"]) == 64,
                 "Select the complete original source hash")
            target = self.out / "inputs" / (item["sha256"] + ".bin")
            if not target.exists():
                with _file_path(item["path"]).open("rb") as source:
                    _publish(_binary_chunks(source), str(target))
            receipt = self.remember(target)
            need(receipt["sha256"] == item["sha256"] and receipt["bytes"] == item["bytes"],
                 "The complete retained source differs from its selected identity")
            received = _stage(workspace, target, item["filename"], item["sha256"], item["bytes"])
            self.files[key] = received
            results.append({"key":key, **received, "artifact":receipt})
        return results

    def catalog(self, workspace, label):
        # A resumed incomplete read keeps each observed revision under its own
        # original name. Completed phase adoption never overwrites an earlier view.
        revision = workspace.project["revision"]
        prefix = label + "/revision-" + str(revision)
        case_entities = {}
        for kind in self.kinds:
            records = list(self.records(workspace, kind))
            case_entities[kind] = records
            self.put(prefix + "/" + kind + ".json", encoded(records))
            for record in records:
                for fmt in ("ndjson", "csv"):
                    path = self.out / prefix / (record["id"] + "." + fmt)
                    ordinary_directory(path.parent, create=True)
                    _publish(workspace.iter_export(self.export_kind(kind), record["id"], format=fmt), str(path))
                    self.remember(path)
        events = list(case_pages(workspace, "events", {}))
        self.put(prefix + "/events.json", encoded(events))
        operations = []
        for operation_id in dict.fromkeys(event.get("operation_id") for event in events if event.get("operation_id")):
            operations.append(workspace.dispatch("operation.get", {"id": operation_id}))
        self.put(prefix + "/operations.json", encoded(operations))
        need(workspace.project["revision"] == revision, "The owned catalogue changed during capture")
        result = {"workspace_id":workspace.project["id"], "revision":revision,
                  self.catalog_key:case_entities, "events":events, "operations":operations}
        self.put(prefix + "/catalog.json", encoded(result))
        return result

    def frozen_catalog(self, workspace, relative, label):
        path = self.out / relative
        if path.exists():
            _, retained = json_file(path)
            for artifact in retained["artifacts"]:
                self.verify(artifact)
            self.remember(path)
            catalog = retained["catalog"]
            need(workspace.project["id"] == catalog["workspace_id"] and
                 workspace.project["revision"] >= catalog["revision"],
                 "The original frozen catalogue no longer belongs to this workspace")
            for kind, records in catalog[self.catalog_key].items():
                for record in records:
                    need(self.get_record(workspace, kind, record["id"]) == record,
                         "A frozen original case edition changed during continuation")
            return catalog
        catalog = self.catalog(workspace, label)
        self.put(relative, encoded({"catalog":catalog, "artifacts":list(self.artifacts.values())}))
        return catalog

    def receive(self, archive, destination, label):
        observed = receive_delivery(archive, destination)
        self.put(label + "-observed-" + identity(observed) + ".json", encoded(observed))
        selected = self.out / (label + ".json")
        stable = lambda value: {key:item for key,item in value.items() if key != "reopened"}
        if selected.exists():
            _, original = json_file(selected)
            need(stable(original) == stable(observed),
                 "Original receiving destination/archive acceptance changed")
            self.remember(selected)
            return original
        self.put(label + ".json", encoded(observed))
        return observed

    def delivery(self, workspace, lane):
        operation_id = identifier(self.operation_id + "-" + lane + "-delivery")
        folder = "deliveries/" + lane
        catalog = self.frozen_catalog(workspace, folder + "/basis.json", lane + "-delivery-basis")
        request_path = self.out / folder / "request.json"
        if request_path.exists():
            _, payload = json_file(request_path)
        else:
            payload = {"operation_id":operation_id, "expected_revision":catalog["revision"],
                       "actor":self.actor_for_lane(lane), "title":self.input.get("title", "Case migration handover"),
                       "note":"Original selected receiving operation " + self.operation_id + " / " + lane}
            self.put(folder + "/request.json", encoded(payload))
        need(payload["expected_revision"] == catalog["revision"],
             "The original delivery request differs from its frozen complete case catalogue")
        self.remember(request_path)
        original = workspace.dispatch("operation.get", {"id":operation_id})
        if original["found"] and original["operation"]["status"] != "SUCCEEDED":
            reason = self.input.get("delivery_resume_reason")
            need(isinstance(reason, str) and reason.strip(),
                 "Keep the interrupted original delivery; use its predeclared reason or the original CLI resume")
            if not self.continue_original(workspace, folder, operation_id, self.actor_for_lane(lane), reason):
                control_path = self.out / folder / "resume-control.json"
                if control_path.exists():
                    _, control = json_file(control_path)
                    need(control["reason"] == reason, "The original delivery continuation reason changed")
                else:
                    control = {"operation_id":identifier(operation_id + "-continue"), "actor":self.actor_for_lane(lane),
                               "expected_revision":workspace.project["revision"],
                               "target_operation_id":operation_id, "reason":reason}
                    self.put(folder + "/resume-control.json", encoded(control))
                workspace.dispatch("operation.resume", control)
        response = workspace.dispatch("delivery.prepare", payload)
        record = response["result"]
        service = PortableService(workspace, workspace.root, SOURCE_ROOT)
        actual, handle = service.open_delivery(record["id"])
        target = self.out / folder / "complete.zip"
        ordinary_directory(target.parent, create=True)
        with handle:
            _publish(_binary_chunks(handle), str(target))
        archive = self.remember(target)
        need(archive["sha256"] == record["archive_sha256"] and archive["bytes"] == record["archive_bytes"],
             "The full original delivery differs")
        inspected = inspect_delivery(target)
        need(inspected["manifest"]["workspace_id"] == catalog["workspace_id"] and
             inspected["manifest"]["revision"] == catalog["revision"],
             "The actual archive snapshot differs from its frozen original case catalogue")
        self.put(folder + "/inspection.json", encoded(inspected))
        accepted = {"record":record, "archive":archive, "manifest_sha256":inspected["manifest_sha256"],
                    "catalog":catalog}
        self.put(folder + "/accepted.json", encoded(accepted))
        return accepted

    def compare_entities(self, original, following, *, exact=False):
        need(original["workspace_id"] == following["workspace_id"], "Portable receiving changed the original project ID")
        for kind in self.kinds:
            old = {row["id"]:row for row in original[self.catalog_key][kind]}
            new = {row["id"]:row for row in following[self.catalog_key][kind]}
            need(not (set(old) - set(new)), "Receiving omitted an original case edition")
            need(all(new[key] == value for key,value in old.items()), "Receiving changed original case evidence")
            if exact:
                need(old == new, "Independent receiving case editions differ from the selected delivery")

    def accept_action(self, accepted):
        need(isinstance(accepted, dict) and accepted.get("lane") in dict(self.lanes) and
             isinstance(accepted.get("original_result"), dict) and "result" in accepted["original_result"],
             "Retain a complete original accepted action")
        selected = accepted["lane"] + ":" + accepted["key"]
        prior = next((item for item in self.action_receipts
                      if item["lane"] == accepted["lane"] and item["key"] == accepted["key"]), None)
        need(prior is None or prior == accepted, "The retained original action acceptance changed")
        if prior is None:
            self.action_receipts.append(accepted)
        self.results[selected] = accepted["original_result"]["result"]

    def adopt_actions(self):
        for lane, key in self.lanes:
            for step in self.input.get(key, []):
                path = self.out / "actions" / lane / step["key"] / "accepted.json"
                if path.exists():
                    _, accepted = json_file(path)
                    need(accepted.get("lane") == lane and accepted.get("key") == step["key"] and
                         accepted.get("operation_id") == step["operation_id"] and
                         accepted.get("operation") == step["operation"],
                         "The accepted action is not the selected original input")
                    self.accept_action(accepted)
                    self.remember(path)

    def verify_action_history(self, workspace, lane):
        for accepted in self.action_receipts:
            if accepted["lane"] != lane:
                continue
            found = workspace.dispatch("operation.get", {"id":accepted["operation_id"]})
            need(found["found"] and found["operation"]["status"] == "SUCCEEDED" and
                 found["operation"]["request_sha256"] == accepted["request_sha256"] and
                 found["operation"]["result"] == accepted["original_result"],
                 "The original accepted operation/history is not retained")

    def comparison(self, workspace):
        selected = self.resolve(self.input["comparison"])
        need(selected["before_id"] != selected["after_id"], "Select two distinct actual rehearsal editions")
        revision = workspace.project["revision"]
        prefix = "rehearsal-comparison/revision-" + str(revision)
        rows, seen, offset, total = [], set(), 0, None
        while True:
            page = workspace.dispatch(self.domain + ".rehearsal.compare", {**selected, "offset":offset, "limit":250})
            current = page.get("total")
            need(isinstance(current, int) and not isinstance(current, bool) and current >= 0 and
                 isinstance(page.get("rows"), list) and page.get("offset") == offset and
                 page.get("before_id") == selected["before_id"] and page.get("after_id") == selected["after_id"],
                 "Retain the complete original rehearsal comparison page")
            if total is None:
                total = current
            need(current == total and len(page["rows"]) <= 250 and offset + len(page["rows"]) <= total,
                 "The original rehearsal comparison population changed")
            for row in page["rows"]:
                key = canonical([row["kind"], row.get("register"), row["key"]])
                need(key not in seen, "The original comparison repeated an identity")
                seen.add(key)
                rows.append(row)
            offset += len(page["rows"])
            need(workspace.project["revision"] == revision, "The comparison changed from its original revision")
            if offset == total:
                break
            need(page["rows"], "The original comparison ended before its complete population")
        value = {"selection":selected, "workspace_id":workspace.project["id"], "revision":revision,
                 "rows":rows, "total":total}
        self.put(prefix + "/complete.json", encoded(value))
        return value

    def run(self):
        source = self.input.get("workspace")
        need(isinstance(source, dict), "Select the actual original workspace")
        producer = self.open(source["path"])
        need(producer.project["id"] == source["id"], "The selected original case identity differs")
        self.adopt_actions()
        complete = self.out / "COMPLETE.json"
        if complete.exists():
            _, saved = json_file(complete)
            need(saved.get("schema") == self.schema and saved.get("state") == "COMPLETE" and
                 saved.get("operation_id") == self.operation_id and saved.get("input_sha256") == self.input_sha and
                 saved.get("selection") == self.selection and saved.get("lifetimes") ==
                 {"workspaces":"CLOSED","children":"NONE_CREATED"} and
                 [phase["phase"] for phase in saved["phases"]] == list(self.phases) and
                 all(phase.get("schema") == self.schema + "/phase" and
                     phase.get("input_sha256") == self.input_sha for phase in saved["phases"]),
                 "The completed original operation/source selection differs")
            for artifact in saved["artifacts"]:
                self.verify(artifact)
            self.verify_action_history(producer, "producer")
            recipient = self.open(self.out / "customer" / "workspace")
            returned = self.open(self.out / "returned" / "workspace")
            self.verify_action_history(recipient, "customer")
            self.verify_action_history(recipient, "producer")
            self.verify_action_history(returned, "customer")
            self.verify_action_history(returned, "producer")
            for index, workspace in ((1, producer), (5, recipient), (8, returned)):
                recorded = saved["phases"][index]["result"]
                catalog = recorded["catalog"] if index != 5 else recorded["after"]
                need(workspace.project["revision"] >= catalog["revision"],
                     "A received workspace lost its original recorded revision")
                for kind, records in catalog[self.catalog_key].items():
                    for record in records:
                        need(self.get_record(workspace, kind, record["id"]) == record,
                             "A received workspace changed an original immutable case edition")
            need(all(w.project["id"] == source["id"] for w in (recipient, returned)),
                 "An independently received project identity differs")
            self.close_all()
            return saved
        first = self.out / "phases" / (self.phases[0] + ".json")
        if not first.exists() and not self.action_receipts:
            need(producer.project["revision"] == source["expected_revision"],
                 "Select the current original case revision before its first intake")
        self.stage(self.phases[0], lambda: {"project":producer.project, "files":self.stage_files(producer)})
        # The originals remain available after completed first-phase adoption.
        if not self.files:
            for item in self.input.get("source_files", []):
                self.files[item["key"]] = {key:item[key] for key in ("sha256","bytes","filename")}
        def actions():
            need(isinstance(self.input.get("steps"), list) and self.input["steps"],
                 "Supply the reviewed source, projection, plan, rehearsal, response and cutover actions")
            values = [self.action(producer, step, "producer") for step in self.input["steps"]]
            catalog = self.catalog(producer, "producer-after-actions")
            need(all(catalog[self.catalog_key][kind] for kind in self.kinds),
                 "The whole receiving claim requires an actual edition in every case register")
            return {"actions":values, "catalog":catalog}
        original_actions = self.stage(self.phases[1], actions)
        self.adopt_actions()
        self.verify_action_history(producer, "producer")
        def reports():
            revision = producer.project["revision"]
            directory = self.out / "reports" / ("revision-" + str(revision))
            ordinary_directory(directory, create=True)
            names = build_reports(producer, directory, source_revision=revision,
                                  title=self.input.get("title", "Case migration handover"), note=self.input["authorization"])
            return {"revision":revision, "files":[self.remember(directory / name) for name in names]}
        self.stage(self.phases[2], reports)
        producer_delivery = self.stage(self.phases[3], lambda:self.delivery(producer, "producer"))
        archive = self.out / producer_delivery["archive"]["path"]
        def receive():
            return self.receive(archive, self.out / "customer", "customer-receive")
        self.stage(self.phases[4], receive)
        customer = self.open(self.out / "customer" / "workspace")
        def customer_actions():
            before = self.frozen_catalog(customer, "customer-baseline.json", "customer-before")
            self.compare_entities(producer_delivery["catalog"], before, exact=True)
            steps = self.input.get("customer_steps")
            need(isinstance(steps,list) and steps, "Supply the actual recipient's reviewed follow-on action")
            values = [self.action(customer, step, "customer") for step in steps]
            after = self.catalog(customer, "customer-after")
            self.compare_entities(before, after)
            comparison = self.comparison(customer)
            return {"before":before, "actions":values, "after":after, "comparison":comparison}
        customer_result = self.stage(self.phases[5], customer_actions)
        self.adopt_actions()
        self.verify_action_history(customer, "producer")
        self.verify_action_history(customer, "customer")
        def older_receiving():
            before = customer.project
            self.close(customer)
            receipt = self.receive(archive, self.out / "customer", "older-receiving-replay")
            current = self.open(self.out / "customer" / "workspace")
            try:
                need(current.project == before, "Earlier delivery receiving overwrote a later recipient edit")
                self.verify_action_history(current, "customer")
            finally:
                self.close(current)
            return {"before":before, "after":before, "receipt":receipt}
        if not (self.out / "phases" / (self.phases[6] + ".json")).exists():
            self.stage(self.phases[6], older_receiving)
            customer = self.open(self.out / "customer" / "workspace")
        else:
            self.stage(self.phases[6], older_receiving)
        customer_delivery = self.stage(self.phases[7], lambda:self.delivery(customer, "customer"))
        def return_receive():
            receipt = self.receive(self.out / customer_delivery["archive"]["path"],
                                   self.out / "returned", "return-receive")
            returned = self.open(self.out / "returned" / "workspace")
            try:
                catalog = self.catalog(returned, "returned")
                self.compare_entities(customer_delivery["catalog"], catalog, exact=True)
                self.verify_action_history(returned, "customer")
                self.verify_action_history(returned, "producer")
            finally:
                self.close(returned)
            return {"receipt":receipt, "catalog":catalog}
        self.stage(self.phases[8], return_receive)
        def replays():
            values = []
            for lane,workspace in (("producer",producer),("customer",customer)):
                before = workspace.project
                for accepted in self.action_receipts:
                    if accepted["lane"] != lane:
                        continue
                    _, request = json_file(self.out / "actions" / lane / accepted["key"] / "request.json")
                    result = workspace.dispatch(accepted["operation"], request["request"])
                    need(result["reused"] is True and result["result"] == accepted["original_result"]["result"],
                         "The exact original request did not return its original accepted result")
                    values.append({"lane":lane, "operation_id":accepted["operation_id"], "original_revision":result["revision"]})
                need(workspace.project == before, "Original request replay changed the actual later project head")
                self.verify_action_history(workspace, lane)
            return values
        self.stage(self.phases[9], replays)
        self.close_all()
        need([phase["phase"] for phase in self.stage_receipts] == list(self.phases), "Keep all ten ordered original phases")

BLOCK = 1024 * 1024


class DeclaredBody:
    def __init__(self, source, size):
        self.source, self.remaining = source, size

    def read(self, size=-1):
        if self.remaining == 0:
            return b""
        size = self.remaining if size is None or size < 0 else min(size, self.remaining)
        value = self.source.read(size)
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("The upload ended before its declared complete length")
        self.remaining -= len(value)
        return value


class WorkbenchHTTPServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = False
    block_on_close = True

    def __init__(self, address, workspace, source_root):
        self.workspace = workspace
        self.source_root = Path(source_root)
        self.portable = PortableService(workspace, workspace.root, self.source_root)
        super().__init__(address, WorkbenchHandler)


class WorkbenchHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "MigrationWorkbench/1"
    sys_version = ""
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.0"

    def log_message(self, pattern, *values):
        # Keep source names, item paths and request payloads out of access logs.
        return

    def _headers(self, status, content_type, length, *, filename=None):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(length))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        self.send_header("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
        self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy",
                         "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; "
                         "img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; "
                         "object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'")
        if filename:
            self.send_header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename*=UTF-8''" + quote(filename, safe=""))
        self.end_headers()

    def _json(self, status, value):
        data = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        self._headers(status, "application/json; charset=utf-8", len(data))
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def _body_length(self, maximum=None):
        values = self.headers.get_all("Content-Length", [])
        if len(values) != 1 or not values[0].isdigit() or self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding"):
            raise ValueError("Use one declared complete Content-Length")
        size = int(values[0])
        if maximum is not None and size > maximum:
            raise ValueError("Use streamed file intake for bulk records")
        return size

    def _same_origin(self):
        origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
        if origin:
            parsed = urlsplit(origin)
            if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or parsed.netloc != self.headers.get("Host"):
                raise PermissionError("Open this workbench directly before making a change")
        fetch_site = self.headers.get("Sec-Fetch-Site")
        if fetch_site == "cross-site":
            raise PermissionError("Cross-site workspace changes are not accepted")

    def _command(self):
        if self.headers.get_content_type() != "application/json":
            raise ValueError("A workspace command must be JSON")
        length = self._body_length(MAX_COMMAND)
        raw = DeclaredBody(self.rfile, length).read()
        value = json.loads(raw)
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or not isinstance(value.get("operation"), str):
            raise ValueError("Choose an original workspace operation")
        payload = value.get("payload", {})
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ValueError("Operation fields must be an object")
        return value["operation"], payload

    def _error(self, error):
        if isinstance(error, (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError)):
            return
        if isinstance(error, MigrationError):
            body = error.as_dict()
            code = body.get("code", "")
            status = (409 if code in {"REVISION_CONFLICT", "OPERATION_ID_REUSED", "OPERATION_REQUIRES_RESUME",
                                     "WORKSPACE_BUSY", "IMMUTABLE_ENTITY"} else
                      404 if code.endswith("NOT_FOUND") else 422)
        elif isinstance(error, PermissionError):
            status, body = 403, {"code": "ORIGIN", "message": str(error)}
        elif isinstance(error, (ValueError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeError, csv.Error)):
            status, body = 422, {"code": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
        elif isinstance(error, OSError):
            status, body = 507, {"code": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
        else:
            status, body = 500, {"code": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
        try:
            self._json(status, {"error": body})
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            pass

    def do_GET(self):
        try:
            parsed = urlsplit(self.path)
            path = parsed.path
            query = parse_qs(parsed.query)
            if path in STATIC:
                relative, content_type = STATIC[path]
                target = self.server.source_root / relative
                if target.is_symlink() or not target.is_file():
                    raise FileNotFoundError("Complete application asset is missing")
                with target.open("rb") as stream:
                    data = stream.read()
                self._headers(200, content_type, len(data))
                self.wfile.write(data)
                return
            if path == "/api/state":
                self._json(200, self.server.workspace.dispatch("state", {}))
                return
            if path == "/api/schema":
                self._json(200, self.server.workspace.dispatch("schema", {}))
                return
            if path == "/api/file-preview":
                sha = query.get("sha256", [""])[0]
                if not HASH.fullmatch(sha):
                    raise ValueError("Choose a retained source file")
                with self.server.workspace.open_file(sha) as stream:
                    raw = stream.read(256 * 1024 + 1)
                truncated = len(raw) > 256 * 1024
                raw = raw[:256 * 1024]
                encoding = query.get("encoding", ["utf-8-sig"])[0]
                if encoding not in ("utf-8", "utf-8-sig", "utf-16", "utf-16-le", "utf-16-be"):
                    raise ValueError("Choose a supported source text encoding")
                decoded = raw.decode(encoding, errors="replace")
                rows = []
                delimiter = query.get("delimiter", [","])[0]
                if delimiter not in (",", ";", "\t", "|"):
                    raise ValueError("Choose comma, semicolon, tab or pipe CSV delimiter")
                reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(decoded, newline=""), delimiter=delimiter)
                for i, row in enumerate(reader):
                    if i >= 6:
                        break
                    rows.append(row)
                self._json(200, {"sha256": sha, "headers": rows[0] if rows else [],
                                 "sample_rows": rows[1:], "truncated": truncated,
                                 "purpose": "Header selection preview; original import parses the full retained bytes"})
                return
            if path == "/api/exports":
                kind = query.get("kind", [""])[0]
                identifier = query.get("id", [""])[0]
                format_name = query.get("format", ["ndjson"])[0]
                if kind not in {"case.dataset", "case.plan", "case.rehearsal", "case.review", "case.cutover",
                                "register.dataset", "register.plan", "register.rehearsal", "register.review", "register.cutover"} | set(financial_workspace.KINDS) | set(property_workspace.KINDS) | set(crf_workspace.KINDS):
                    raise ValueError("Choose a complete retained workbench record export")
                if format_name not in {"ndjson", "csv"}:
                    raise ValueError("Choose NDJSON or CSV")
                # Finish the retained generator before sending headers. Its mutex
                # binds the complete export to the original immutable selection.
                with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode="w+b") as output:
                    for chunk in self.server.workspace.iter_export(kind, identifier, format=format_name):
                        output.write(chunk)
                    length = output.tell()
                    output.seek(0)
                    self._headers(200, "text/csv; charset=utf-8" if format_name == "csv" else "application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8",
                                  length, filename=kind + "-" + identifier + "." + format_name)
                    while part := output.read(BLOCK):
                        self.wfile.write(part)
                return
            if path.startswith("/api/files/"):
                sha = path[len("/api/files/"):]
                if not HASH.fullmatch(sha):
                    raise ValueError("Choose a retained source file")
                info = self.server.workspace.file_info(sha)
                filename = query.get("filename", [sha])[0]
                with self.server.workspace.open_file(sha) as stream:
                    self._headers(200, "application/octet-stream", info["bytes"], filename=filename)
                    while part := stream.read(BLOCK):
                        self.wfile.write(part)
                return
            if path.startswith("/api/deliveries/"):
                identifier = path[len("/api/deliveries/"):]
                record, stream = self.server.portable.open_delivery(identifier)
                with stream:
                    self._headers(200, "application/zip", record["archive_bytes"], filename=record["filename"])
                    while part := stream.read(BLOCK):
                        self.wfile.write(part)
                return
            self._json(404, {"error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "Workbench route not found"}})
        except Exception as error:
            self._error(error)

    def do_POST(self):
        try:
            self._same_origin()
            parsed = urlsplit(self.path)
            if parsed.path == "/api/files":
                size = self._body_length()
                filename = parse_qs(parsed.query).get("filename", [""])[0]
                original = self.server.workspace.stage_file(DeclaredBody(self.rfile, size), filename,
                                                            expected_bytes=size)
                self._json(201, original)
                return
            if parsed.path not in ("/api/read", "/api/operations"):
                self._json(404, {"error": {"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "Workbench route not found"}})
                return
            operation, payload = self._command()
            if parsed.path == "/api/read":
                if operation not in READS:
                    raise ValueError("Choose a supported read operation")
                result = self.server.workspace.dispatch(operation, payload)
            else:
                result = self.server.workspace.dispatch(operation, payload)
            self._json(200, result)
        except Exception as error:
            self._error(error)


def serve(workspace, *, host="127.0.0.1", port=8083, source_root=None):
    source_root = Path(source_root) if source_root is not None else Path(__file__).parent
    server = WorkbenchHTTPServer((host, port), workspace, source_root)
    actual_host, actual_port = server.server_address[:2]
    print(json.dumps({"event": "migration_workbench_ready", "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"],
                      "revision": workspace.project["revision"],
                      "url": "http://" + actual_host + ":" + str(actual_port)}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.25)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, help="Original editable workspace directory")
    parser.add_argument("--create", action="store_true", help="Create a genuinely new workspace")
    parser.add_argument("--title", default="Migration workbench")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8083)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    with MigrationWorkspace(args.workspace, create=args.create, title=args.title) as workspace:
        serve(workspace, host=args.host, port=args.port)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
