def _ready_row(store, row_id):
    row = row_description(store,row_id)
    if row["source_ref"]["source_status"]!="READY":
        raise MigrationError("INCOMPLETE_SOURCE", "Only a completely parsed original source can join a reviewed operation", {"row_id":row_id})
    return row

def _row_filters(selector, alias="r"):
    where, args = [f"{alias}.source_id=?"], [selector["source_id"]]
    for key in ("task_id","round_label","job_id"):
        if key in selector:
            where.append(f"{alias}.{key}=?")
            args.append(selector[key])
    return " AND ".join(where),args

def _round(store, op):
    p = op["request"]
    entity_id = "round-"+identity({"operation":op["id"],"request":op["request_sha256"]})[:40]
    old = store.get_entity("round",entity_id,required=False)
    if old:
        return old
    for name in ("title","scope_id","round_label"):
        text(p.get(name),name)
    selectors = p.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(selectors,list) or not selectors or len(selectors)>10000:
        raise MigrationError("ROUND_SOURCES", "Select between 1 and 10,000 original source selectors")
    snapshots = []
    for selected in selectors:
        if not isinstance(selected,dict) or set(selected)-{"source_id","task_id","round_label","job_id"}:
            raise MigrationError("ROUND_SELECTOR", "Use original source_id and exact optional task/round/job fields")
        selector = dict(selected)
        source = source_description(store,selector.get("source_id"))
        if source["status"]!="READY":
            raise MigrationError("INCOMPLETE_SOURCE", "Round requires a complete original source import")
        if source["context"]["scope_id"]!=p["scope_id"]:
            raise MigrationError("ROUND_SCOPE", "Original source has a different declared scope", {"source_id":source["id"],"scope_id":source["context"]["scope_id"]})
        for key in ("task_id","round_label","job_id"):
            if key in selector:
                text(selector[key],key)
        where,args = _row_filters(selector)
        with store.transaction():
            store.conn.execute(f"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO round_members SELECT ?,r.id FROM rows r WHERE {where}",(entity_id,*args))
        selected_count = store.conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM rows r WHERE {where}",args).fetchone()[0]
        snapshots.append({"source_id":source["id"],"sha256":source["file_sha256"],"bytes":source["bytes"],
                          "format":source["format"],"role":source["context"]["role"],"context":source["context"],
                          "selector":selector,"selected_occurrences":selected_count,"summary":source["summary"]})
    if p.get("parent_round_id"):
        parent = store.get_entity("round",p["parent_round_id"])
        if parent["scope_id"]!=p["scope_id"]:
            raise MigrationError("ROUND_PARENT", "Previous round belongs to another scope")
    count = store.conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM round_members WHERE round_id=?", (entity_id,)).fetchone()[0]
    body = {"schema":"ma-dor.migration-round/v1","id":entity_id,"title":p["title"],"scope_id":p["scope_id"],
            "round_label":p["round_label"],"task_id":p.get("task_id"),"parent_round_id":p.get("parent_round_id"),
            "note":p.get("note"),"sources":snapshots,"selected_occurrences":count,
            "created_at":op["created_at"],"created_revision":op["reserved_revision"],"operation_id":op["id"],"actor":op["actor"],
            "meaning":"Explicit frozen selection of original occurrences. The label does not replace any reported task or incremental-round value."}
    return store.put_entity("round",entity_id,body,op["reserved_revision"])

def _validate_entry(store, kind, entry):
    if not isinstance(entry,dict):
        raise MigrationError("MAPPING_ENTRY", "Mapping entries must be objects")
    entry = dict(entry)
    if kind=="identity":
        left = _ready_row(store,entry.get("source_row_id"))
        right = _ready_row(store,entry.get("target_row_id"))
        if left["role"]!="source_inventory" or right["role"] not in ("target_inventory","migration_items","migration_failures"):
            raise MigrationError("IDENTITY_MAPPING_ROLE", "Link a source inventory occurrence to a target/report occurrence")
        text(entry.get("reason"),"entry.reason")
        entry["source_ref"],entry["target_ref"] = left["source_ref"],right["source_ref"]
    elif kind=="principal":
        text(entry.get("source_principal"),"source_principal",max_length=4096)
        text(entry.get("target_principal"),"target_principal",max_length=4096)
        if not isinstance(entry.get("is_group"),bool):
            raise MigrationError("PRINCIPAL_MAPPING", "is_group must explicitly be true or false")
    elif kind=="status":
        text(entry.get("raw_status"),"raw_status",max_length=4096)
        if entry.get("classification") not in CLASSIFICATIONS:
            raise MigrationError("STATUS_MAPPING", "Use an advertised reported-status classification")
    elif kind=="evidence":
        subject = _ready_row(store,entry.get("subject_row_id"))
        evidence = _ready_row(store,entry.get("evidence_row_id"))
        fields = entry.get("fields")
        if not isinstance(fields,list) or not fields or len(set(fields))!=len(fields) or any(f not in EVIDENCE_FIELDS for f in fields):
            raise MigrationError("EVIDENCE_FIELDS", "Select unique advertised evidence fields")
        text(entry.get("reason"),"reason")
        entry["subject_ref"],entry["evidence_ref"] = subject["source_ref"],evidence["source_ref"]
    if entry.get("reason") is not None:
        text(entry["reason"],"entry.reason")
    return entry

def _mapping(store, op):
    p = op["request"]
    mapping_id = "mapping-"+identity({"operation":op["id"],"request":op["request_sha256"]})[:40]
    old = store.get_entity("mapping",mapping_id,required=False)
    if old:
        return old
    text(p.get("title"),"title")
    text(p.get("review_note"),"review_note")
    kind = p.get("kind")
    if kind not in ("identity","principal","status","evidence"):
        raise MigrationError("MAPPING_KIND", "Unknown reviewed mapping kind")
    use_source = p.get("source_id") is not None
    if use_source == ("entries" in p):
        raise MigrationError("MAPPING_SOURCE", "Provide one original source_id or one inline entries array")
    source_snapshot = None
    if use_source:
        source_snapshot = source_description(store,p["source_id"])
        expected_format = {"identity":"identity_mapping_jsonl","principal":"user_mapping_csv","status":"status_mapping_jsonl","evidence":"evidence_mapping_jsonl"}[kind]
        if source_snapshot["status"]!="READY" or source_snapshot["format"]!=expected_format:
            raise MigrationError("MAPPING_SOURCE", "Mapping source format/status does not match selected kind")
        def entries():
            for saved in store.conn.execute("SELECT id,values_json,issues_json FROM rows WHERE source_id=? ORDER BY ordinal", (p["source_id"],)):
                issues = parse_json(saved["issues_json"])
                if kind=="principal" and any(issue.get("code")=="invalid_official_user_mapping_row" for issue in issues):
                    raise MigrationError("USER_MAPPING_SHAPE", "Invalid original headerless mapping row cannot become a reviewed map; retain and import an explicitly corrected source edition",
                                         {"source_row_id":saved["id"],"issues":issues})
                obj = parse_json(saved["values_json"]).get("mapping_entry")
                yield obj,{"row_id":saved["id"],"source_id":p["source_id"],"sha256":source_snapshot["file_sha256"]}
    else:
        inline = p.get("entries")
        if not isinstance(inline,list) or not inline or len(inline)>1000:
            raise MigrationError("MAPPING_ENTRIES", "Use 1–1,000 inline entries or a streamed original mapping file")
        def entries():
            for index,obj in enumerate(inline,1):
                yield obj,{"operation_id":op["id"],"inline_entry":index}
    options = p.get("options",{})
    if not isinstance(options,dict):
        raise MigrationError("MAPPING_OPTIONS", "Mapping options must be an object")
    if kind=="principal" and options.get("entra_fallback","unknown") not in ("enabled","disabled","unknown"):
        raise MigrationError("ENTRA_FALLBACK", "Retain enabled, disabled or unknown fallback")
    if p.get("parent_mapping_id"):
        parent = store.get_entity("mapping",p["parent_mapping_id"])
        if parent["kind"]!=kind:
            raise MigrationError("MAPPING_PARENT", "Previous mapping has a different kind")
    count, active = 0, False
    try:
        for count,(entry,source_ref) in enumerate(entries(),1):
            clean = _validate_entry(store,kind,entry)
            clean["id"] = "maprow-"+identity({"mapping_id":mapping_id,"ordinal":count})[:40]
            clean["source_record"] = source_ref
            if kind=="principal" and use_source:
                src = clean["source_principal"]
                dst = clean["target_principal"]
                if "\\" not in src or not all(src.split("\\",1)) or dst.count("@")!=1 or any(c.isspace() for c in dst):
                    raise MigrationError("USER_MAPPING_SHAPE", "Official mapping needs source DOMAIN\\user and a destination UPN", {"source_row_id":source_ref["row_id"]})
            record = (clean["id"],mapping_id,count,kind,canonical(clean),
                      clean.get("source_row_id") or clean.get("subject_row_id"),
                      clean.get("target_row_id") or clean.get("evidence_row_id"),
                      clean.get("source_principal"),clean.get("target_principal"),clean.get("raw_status"))
            prior = store.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM mapping_entries WHERE mapping_id=? AND ordinal=?", (mapping_id,count)).fetchone()
            if prior:
                if tuple(prior)!=record:
                    raise MigrationError("MAPPING_PREFIX_CHANGED", "Original mapping occurrence changed on continuation")
                continue
            if not active:
                store.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                active = True
            store.conn.execute("INSERT INTO mapping_entries VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",record)
            if count%250==0:
                store.conn.execute("UPDATE operations SET checkpoint_json=? WHERE id=?", (canonical({"phase":"mapping","mapping_id":mapping_id,"entries_retained":count}),op["id"]))
                store.conn.execute("COMMIT")
                active = False
        if active:
            store.conn.execute("COMMIT")
            active = False
        if count==0:
            raise MigrationError("EMPTY_MAPPING", "Reviewed mapping has no entries")
        retained = store.conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM mapping_entries WHERE mapping_id=?", (mapping_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        if retained!=count:
            raise MigrationError("MAPPING_PREFIX_CHANGED", "Original mapping ends before retained rows")
        body = {"schema":"ma-dor.reviewed-mapping/v1","id":mapping_id,"title":p["title"],"kind":kind,"entry_count":count,
                "source_id":p.get("source_id"),"source_snapshot":source_snapshot,
                "review_note":p["review_note"],"options":options,"parent_mapping_id":p.get("parent_mapping_id"),
                "created_at":op["created_at"],"created_revision":op["reserved_revision"],"operation_id":op["id"],"actor":op["actor"],
                "meaning":"Explicit reviewer mapping of supplied evidence; no identity lookup, target write, group expansion or effective-ACL inference"}
        return store.put_entity("mapping",mapping_id,body,op["reserved_revision"])
    finally:
        if active and store.conn.in_transaction:
            store.conn.execute("ROLLBACK")

def _correction_update(store, op):
    p = op["request"]
    update_id = "correction-update-"+identity({"operation":op["id"],"request":op["request_sha256"]})[:40]
    prior = store.conn.execute("SELECT body_json FROM correction_updates WHERE id=?", (update_id,)).fetchone()
    if prior:
        return parse_json(prior[0])
    original = store.get_entity("correction",p.get("id"))
    status = p.get("status")
    if status not in ("open","in_progress","waiting_evidence","resolved","accepted_variance","withdrawn"):
        raise MigrationError("CORRECTION_STATUS", "Choose an advertised correction status")
    text(p.get("note"),"note")
    refs = _evidence_rows(store,p.get("evidence_row_ids",[]))
    if "assigned_to" in p and p["assigned_to"] is not None:
        text(p["assigned_to"],"assigned_to")
    latest = store.conn.execute("SELECT body_json FROM correction_updates WHERE correction_id=? ORDER BY revision DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1",(original["id"],)).fetchone()
    previous_assignment = parse_json(latest[0]).get("assigned_to") if latest else original.get("assigned_to")
    assigned_to = p["assigned_to"] if "assigned_to" in p else previous_assignment
    verification = p.get("verification")
    if status=="resolved":
        if not isinstance(verification,dict) or not original.get("expected_row_id"):
            raise MigrationError("VERIFICATION_REQUIRED", "Resolution needs a later MATCH for the same retained baseline occurrence; other closures can record accepted_variance with reasons")
        rec = store.get_entity("reconciliation",verification.get("reconciliation_id"))
        item = _item(store,verification.get("item_id"),rec["id"])
        old_rec = store.get_entity("reconciliation",original["reconciliation_id"])
        if rec["created_revision"]<=old_rec["created_revision"] or item["expected_row_id"]!=original["expected_row_id"] or item["status"]!="MATCH":
            raise MigrationError("VERIFICATION_REQUIRED", "Verification must be a later matching result for exactly the original baseline row")
        if not set(original["required_checks"]) <= set(rec["configuration"]["checks"]):
            raise MigrationError("VERIFICATION_WEAKENED", "Later result omitted original required checks")
        if any(item["checks"].get(k,{}).get("status")!="MATCH" for k in original["original_problem_checks"]):
            raise MigrationError("VERIFICATION_WEAKENED", "Later evidence did not resolve every original problem check")
        verification = {"reconciliation_id":rec["id"],"item_id":item["id"],"expected_row_id":item["expected_row_id"],
                        "status":item["status"],"original_source_ref":item.get("expected_source_ref"),"observed_source_ref":item.get("observed_source_ref")}
    elif verification is not None:
        rec = store.get_entity("reconciliation",verification.get("reconciliation_id"))
        item = _item(store,verification.get("item_id"),rec["id"])
        verification = {"reconciliation_id":rec["id"],"item_id":item["id"],"status":item["status"]}
    body = {"schema":"ma-dor.correction-update/v1","id":update_id,"correction_id":original["id"],"status":status,
            "note":p["note"],"assigned_to":assigned_to,"evidence_rows":refs,"verification":verification,
            "created_at":op["created_at"],"created_revision":op["reserved_revision"],"operation_id":op["id"],"actor":op["actor"],
            "meaning":"Reviewer history; original source rows and frozen reconciliation remain unchanged"}
    with store.transaction():
        store.conn.execute("INSERT INTO correction_updates VALUES(?,?,?,?)", (update_id,original["id"],op["reserved_revision"],canonical(body)))
    return body

class MigrationWorkspace(Store):
    def __init__(self, directory, *, create=False, title="Migration workbench"):
        super().__init__(directory,create=create,title=title)
        try:
            migration_cases.ensure(self)
            financial_workspace.ensure(self)
            migration_registers.ensure(self)
            property_workspace.ensure(self)
            crf_workspace.ensure(self)
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def _handler(self, operation):
        if operation in crf_workspace.HANDLERS:
            return lambda op:crf_workspace.invoke(self,op)
        if operation in migration_registers.HANDLERS:
            return lambda op:migration_registers.HANDLERS[operation](self,op)
        if operation in property_workspace.HANDLERS:
            return lambda op:property_workspace.invoke(self,op)
        if operation in financial_workspace.HANDLERS:
            return lambda op:financial_workspace.invoke(self,op)
        if operation in migration_cases.HANDLERS:
            return lambda op:migration_cases.HANDLERS[operation](self,op)
        handlers = {"workspace.update":_workspace_update,"source.import":import_source,"round.create":_round,
                    "mapping.create":_mapping,"evidence.link":_evidence_link,"reconciliation.create":reconcile,
                    "correction.create":_correction_create,"correction.update":_correction_update}
        if operation in handlers:
            return lambda op:handlers[operation](self,op)
        if operation=="delivery.prepare":
            from migration_portable import continue_delivery
            return lambda op:continue_delivery(self,op)
        if operation=="operation.resume":
            def resume(op):
                p = op["request"]
                text(p.get("reason"),"reason")
                target = self._operation(p.get("target_operation_id"))
                if target["operation"]=="operation.resume" or target["id"]==op["id"]:
                    raise MigrationError("RESUME_TARGET", "Select the original local operation, not a resume-control request")
                handler = self._handler(target["operation"])
                result = self.resume_original(target["id"],actor=op["actor"],reason=p["reason"],
                                              expected_revision=self.project["revision"],handler=handler)
                return {"id":target["id"],"target_operation_id":target["id"],"original_operation":target["operation"],"resumed":result}
            return resume
        raise MigrationError("UNKNOWN_OPERATION", "Unknown mutation", {"operation":operation})

    def dispatch(self, operation, payload=None):
        p = {} if payload is None else payload
        if not isinstance(p,dict):
            raise MigrationError("INVALID_PAYLOAD", "Payload must be an object")
        with self._mutex:
            if operation=="delivery.prepare":
                from migration_portable import prepare_delivery
                return prepare_delivery(self,p)
            if operation in MUTATIONS:
                return self.execute(operation,p,self._handler(operation))
            if operation in migration_registers.READS:
                return migration_registers.read(self,operation,p)
            if operation in migration_cases.READS:
                return migration_cases.read(self,operation,p)
            if operation in financial_workspace.READS:
                return financial_workspace.read(self,operation,p)
            if operation in property_workspace.READS:
                return property_workspace.read(self,operation,p)
            if operation in crf_workspace.READS:
                return crf_workspace.read(self,operation,p)
            if operation=="schema":
                return schema()
            if operation=="state":
                return self.state()
            if operation=="source.get":
                return source_description(self,p.get("id"))
            if operation=="source.list":
                return self.entity_list({**p,"kind":"source"})
            if operation=="entity.list":
                return self.entity_list(p)
            if operation=="source.rows":
                return self.source_rows(p)
            if operation=="row.get":
                return row_description(self,p.get("id"))
            if operation=="mapping.rows":
                self.get_entity("mapping",p.get("id"))
                offset,limit = page(p)
                total = self.conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM mapping_entries WHERE mapping_id=?",(p["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                rows = [parse_json(r[0]) for r in self.conn.execute("SELECT body_json FROM mapping_entries WHERE mapping_id=? ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(p["id"],limit,offset))]
                return {"rows":rows,"total":total,"offset":offset,"limit":limit}
            if operation=="reconciliation.items":
                return self.reconciliation_items(p)
            if operation=="reconciliation.compare":
                offset,limit = page(p)
                return compare_reconciliations(self,p.get("before_id"),p.get("after_id"),offset=offset,limit=limit)
            if operation=="correction.get":
                return self.correction_get(p.get("id"))
            if operation=="correction.history":
                self.get_entity("correction",p.get("id"))
                offset,limit = page(p)
                total = self.conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM correction_updates WHERE correction_id=?",(p["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                rows = [parse_json(r[0]) for r in self.conn.execute("SELECT body_json FROM correction_updates WHERE correction_id=? ORDER BY revision,id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(p["id"],limit,offset))]
                return {"rows":rows,"total":total,"offset":offset,"limit":limit}
            if operation=="operation.get":
                result = self._operation(p.get("id"),required=False)
                return {"found":bool(result),"operation":result}
            if operation=="events":
                offset,limit = page(p)
                total = self.conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events").fetchone()[0]
                rows = []
                for saved in self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY revision LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(limit,offset)):
                    row = dict(saved)
                    row["payload"] = parse_json(row.pop("payload_json"))
                    rows.append(row)
                return {"rows":rows,"total":total,"offset":offset,"limit":limit}
            for kind in ("round","mapping","evidence_link","reconciliation","correction","delivery"):
                if operation==kind+".get":
                    return self.get_entity(kind,p.get("id"))
                if operation==kind+".list":
                    offset,limit = page(p)
                    return self.entity_list({**p,"kind":kind})
            raise MigrationError("UNKNOWN_OPERATION", "Unknown read operation", {"operation":operation})

    def entity_list(self, p):
        kind = p.get("kind")
        kinds = ("source","round","mapping","evidence_link","reconciliation","correction","delivery","workspace_edit")

        if kind not in kinds:
            raise MigrationError("ENTITY_KIND", "Choose an advertised retained entity kind", {"kinds":list(kinds)})
        offset,limit = page(p)
        query = p.get("query")
        if query is not None:
            text(query,"query",max_length=4096)
        if kind=="source":
            where,args = (" WHERE instr(lower(id||filename||context_json),lower(?))>0",[query]) if query else ("",[])
            total = self.conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM sources"+where,args).fetchone()[0]
            ids = [r[0] for r in self.conn.execute("SELECT id FROM sources"+where+" ORDER BY created_revision DESC,id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(*args,limit,offset))]

        if p.get("status"):

    def correction_get(self, correction_id):
        original = self.get_entity("correction",correction_id)
        saved = self.conn.execute("SELECT body_json FROM correction_updates WHERE correction_id=? ORDER BY revision DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1",(correction_id,)).fetchone()
        current = parse_json(saved[0]) if saved else original
        history = [parse_json(r[0]) for r in self.conn.execute("SELECT body_json FROM correction_updates WHERE correction_id=? ORDER BY revision DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100",(correction_id,))]
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM correction_updates WHERE correction_id=?",(correction_id,)).fetchone()[0]

                    "revision","archive_bytes","archive_sha256","file_count","manifest_sha256","assigned_to")
            summaries = []

        return {"schema":"ma-dor.operating-state/v1","project":project,**collections,"collection_totals":totals,
                "operations":operations,"recent_events":events,"collection_limit":100}

    def iter_export(self, kind, entity_id, *, format="ndjson"):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reviewed grant intake over the existing case migration/portable receiving operation."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import fcntl
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from case_receiving import Receiving, json_file, need, SCHEMA as RECEIVING_SCHEMA, INPUT_LIMIT
from migration_store import canonical, identifier, file_hash
from migration_cases import stamp, destination_policy

SCHEMA = "commons.grant-migration-contract/v1"
FAMILIES = ("persons","organisations","programmes","rounds","forms","applications",
            "reviewers","panels","assignments","conflicts","reviews","awards","amendments",
            "milestones","reports","documents","document_links","payment_requests",
            "payment_approvals","disbursements","refunds","workflows","access","integrations")
MEANING = {
    "customer_migration":"Supplied original institution exports and independent F1 target returns; no vendor write or payment instruction.",
    "public_reference_review":"Operator-authored review of public vendor requirements; no tenant rows, vendor import or migrated-customer result."
}

def result_ref(value, lane="producer"):
    need(isinstance(value,dict) and set(value)=={"$result","pointer"} and
         isinstance(value["$result"],str) and value["$result"].startswith(lane+":") and
         value["pointer"]=="/id", "Use the exact original producer result ID reference")
    return value["$result"].split(":",1)[1]

def string(value, label):
    need(isinstance(value,str) and value.strip(), "Retain the complete "+label)
    return value

def validate_input(value):
    """Inspect original action bytes without opening a workspace or dispatching an import."""
    need(isinstance(value,dict) and value.get("schema")==RECEIVING_SCHEMA,
         "Use the existing complete case receiving input")
    contract=value.get("grant_contract")
    need(isinstance(contract,dict) and contract.get("schema")==SCHEMA,"Supply the reviewed grant contract")
    mode=contract.get("mode")
    need(mode in MEANING,"Declare actual customer migration or public reference review")
    for name in ("title","scope_note","source_owner","target_loader","acceptance_owner"):
        string(contract.get(name),name)
    family_rules=contract.get("families")
    omitted=contract.get("excluded_families")
    need(isinstance(family_rules,dict) and family_rules and isinstance(omitted,dict),
         "Declare each included family and every excluded family with a reason")
    need(set(family_rules)<=set(FAMILIES) and set(omitted)<=set(FAMILIES) and
         not set(family_rules)&set(omitted) and set(family_rules)|set(omitted)==set(FAMILIES),
         "Account explicitly for every grant family without inventing absent populations")
    for family,reason in omitted.items():string(reason,"exclusion for "+family)
    for family,rule in family_rules.items():
        need(isinstance(rule,dict) and rule.get("kind") in ("cases","documents","links"),
             "Use existing cases/documents/links for "+family)
        identifier(rule.get("identity_scope"))
        string(rule.get("meaning"),"record meaning for "+family)
        fields=rule.get("compare_fields")
        need(isinstance(fields,list) and fields and all(isinstance(x,str) and x for x in fields) and len(fields)==len(set(fields)),
             "Select the exact comparison fields for "+family)
    files={}
    for item in value.get("source_files",[]):
        key=identifier(item.get("key"));need(key not in files,"Original source keys must be unique");files[key]=item
    evidence=contract.get("interface_evidence")
    need(isinstance(evidence,list) and evidence,"Retain supplied template/return/workflow evidence or explicit missing status")
    evidence_kinds=set()
    for item in evidence:
        need(isinstance(item,dict) and item.get("kind") in
             ("source_export","target_template","target_return","document_return","roles","workflow","integration","public_source"),
             "Use an explicit interface evidence kind")
        evidence_kinds.add(item["kind"])
        need(item.get("status") in ("retained","missing","not_applicable"),"Record actual interface evidence status")
        string(item.get("description"),"interface evidence description")
        if item["status"]=="retained":
            need(item.get("source_file") in files,"Bind evidence to a complete original source_files member")
        else:string(item.get("reason"),"missing or excluded evidence reason")
    if mode=="customer_migration":
        need({"source_export","target_template","target_return","document_return","roles","workflow","integration"}<=evidence_kinds,
             "Account for the original export, template, independent return, documents, roles, workflow and integrations")
    else:
        need("public_source" in evidence_kinds,"Bind the public example to its retained source register")
    steps={}
    all_ids=set()
    for lane,field in (("producer","steps"),("customer","customer_steps")):
        for step in value.get(field,[]):
            key=(lane,identifier(step.get("key")));need(key not in steps,"Keep action keys unique")
            need(step.get("operation_id") not in all_ids,"Keep original action IDs unique")
            all_ids.add(step.get("operation_id"));steps[key]=step
    def action(key,operation):
        item=steps.get(("producer",key))
        need(item and item.get("operation")==operation,"Select the original producer "+operation+" action")
        return item["payload"]
    def import_for(dataset,side):
        imported=action(result_ref(dataset.get("source_id")),"source.import")
        context=imported.get("context",{})
        need(context.get("role")==("source_inventory" if side=="source" else "target_inventory"),
             "Independent target observations cannot be replaced by loader receipts")
        coverage=context.get("coverage")
        need(isinstance(coverage,dict) and coverage.get("mode") in ("complete","partial","failure_only","unknown") and
             isinstance(coverage.get("description"),str) and coverage["description"].strip(),
             "Retain actual population coverage for every family occurrence")
        expected="customer_export" if mode=="customer_migration" else None
        if expected:need(context.get("capture_kind")==expected,"Real receiving requires the selected institution export/return")
        else:need(context.get("capture_kind") in ("public_reference","local_reference"),
                  "Public requirements review must stay visibly separate from customer data")
        stamp(context.get("captured_at"),"actual capture time")
        return imported
    periods=contract.get("periods")
    need(isinstance(periods,list) and len(periods)==2,"Select exactly two complete reviewed editions")
    summaries=[];rehearsals=[]
    for period in periods:
        need(isinstance(period,dict),"Supply a complete period selection")
        label=string(period.get("label"),"period label")
        cutoff=stamp(period.get("cutoff_at"),"period cutoff")
        plan_key=identifier(period.get("plan_key"));rehearsal_key=identifier(period.get("rehearsal_key"))
        plan=action(plan_key,"case.plan.create");rehearsal=action(rehearsal_key,"case.rehearsal.create")
        need(stamp(plan.get("cutoff_at"),"plan cutoff")==cutoff and
             result_ref(rehearsal.get("plan_id"))==plan_key,"Bind each actual rehearsal to its exact cutoff plan")
        need("destination_policy" in plan,"Select grant destinations explicitly; do not inherit the original Dynamics defaults")
        destination_policy(plan["destination_policy"])
        selected={}
        for side,refs in (("source",plan.get("source_dataset_ids")),("target",rehearsal.get("target_dataset_ids"))):
            need(isinstance(refs,list) and refs,"Select the complete "+side+" family projection list")
            population={}
            for ref in refs:
                ds=action(result_ref(ref),"case.dataset.create")
                need(ds.get("side")==side,"The selected projection has another evidence side")
                family=ds.get("record_family");need(family in family_rules,"Declare the selected original record family")
                rule=family_rules[family]
                identity_field="case_id" if rule["kind"]=="cases" else "document_id"
                need(ds.get("kind")==rule["kind"] and ds.get("identity_scopes",{}).get(identity_field)==rule["identity_scope"],
                     "Use the declared kind and exact family identity scope")
                need(set(rule["compare_fields"])<=set(ds.get("columns",{})),
                     "Map every explicitly reviewed comparison field on source and target")
                import_for(ds,side)
                population.setdefault(family,[]).append(result_ref(ref))
            need(set(population)==set(family_rules),"Keep all included families visible in both selected populations")
            selected[side]=population
        checks=plan.get("family_checks",{})
        for family,rule in family_rules.items():
            need(checks.get(family)==rule["compare_fields"],"Freeze the exact per-family comparison selection")
        rules=plan.get("relation_rules")
        need(isinstance(rules,list),"Declare all reviewed relationships, including an explicit empty list when none")
        summaries.append({"label":label,"cutoff_at":period["cutoff_at"],"plan_key":plan_key,
                          "rehearsal_key":rehearsal_key,"families":selected,"relation_rule_count":len(rules)})
        rehearsals.append(rehearsal_key)
    need(rehearsals[0]!=rehearsals[1] and periods[0]["label"]!=periods[1]["label"],
         "Keep the two original editions separately identified")
    need(stamp(periods[1]["cutoff_at"],"second cutoff")>stamp(periods[0]["cutoff_at"],"first cutoff"),
         "The later edition must have a later explicit cutoff")
    comparison=value.get("comparison",{})
    need(result_ref(comparison.get("before_id"))==rehearsals[0] and
         result_ref(comparison.get("after_id"))==rehearsals[1],"Compare the exact two selected rehearsal editions")
    return {"schema":SCHEMA,"mode":mode,"title":contract["title"],"meaning":MEANING[mode],
            "included_families":list(family_rules),"excluded_families":omitted,
            "periods":summaries,"interface_evidence":evidence,"vendor_dispatch":False,
            "payment_instruction":False,"acceptance_inferred":False}

class GrantReceiving(Receiving):
    def __init__(self,source_input,out):
        # The exact same bytes are reread/bound by Receiving before any source/workspace action.
        raw,value=json_file(source_input,INPUT_LIMIT)
        self.grant_validation=validate_input(value)
        super().__init__(source_input,out)
        need(self.raw==raw,"The reviewed original input changed during admission")
        self.put("grant-contract-review.json",(canonical(self.grant_validation)+"\n").encode("utf-8"))

def main(argv=None):
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--input",required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out",help="Existing original operation directory for run/continuation")
    parser.add_argument("--inspect",action="store_true",help="Read the complete intake contract; no workspace or provider action")
    args=parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.inspect:
        _,value=json_file(args.input,INPUT_LIMIT)
        print(canonical(validate_input(value)));return 0
    need(args.out,"Choose the original operation output directory")
    runner=GrantReceiving.__new__(GrantReceiving);runner.owned=[];runner.lock=None
    try:
        runner.__init__(args.input,args.out);report=runner.run()
        print(canonical({"state":report["state"],"operation_id":report["operation_id"],
                         "report":str(runner.out/"COMPLETE.json"),"phases":len(report["phases"]),
                         "grant_contract":runner.grant_validation}))
        return 0
    except BaseException as error:
        try:runner.close_all()
        except BaseException as close_error:
            print(canonical({"state":"INTERRUPTED","error":str(error),"close_error":str(close_error)}),file=sys.stderr);return 2
        print(canonical({"state":"INTERRUPTED","error":type(error).__name__,"message":str(error)}),file=sys.stderr);return 2
    finally:
        if not runner.owned and runner.lock is not None:
            fcntl.flock(runner.lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN);os.close(runner.lock);runner.lock=None

if __name__=="__main__":raise SystemExit(main())

# Grant migration mapping, reconciliation and receiving

This is an extension of the existing migration workbench. It retains the original SQLite history, complete CSV/JSONL source files, case/document engine, browser, HTTP/CLI actions, reviewer decisions and portable receivers. It does not implement a Grant Tracker exporter, OmniStar loader, HMAC client, tenant write or payment operation.

## Vendor and institutional boundaries

The following public sources establish the operating requirements. They do not provide the selected institution's export schema, data, target template or acceptance.

| Source | What it establishes | What must still be supplied |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Symplectic announcement, 14 July 2025](https://www.symplectic.co.uk/blog/important-update-symplectic-grant-tracker-to-be-sunset-by-december-2026/) | Planned Grant Tracker sunset on 31 December 2026; individual customer offboarding applies. | Actual customer notice, retention agreement and cutoff. |
| [OmniStar migration toolkit](https://www.omnistar.cloud/compare/symplectic-omnistar-migration-toolkit) | Existing automated/hybrid services and migration of applications, panels, workflows, reviewers, programmes, documents, awards, payments, reports, integrations, access and training. | Selected migration route, configuration decisions and full original populations. |
| [OmniStar security and data access](https://www.omnistar.cloud/security) | Standard migration templates; complex implementation migration service; ID-bearing spreadsheet exports; vendor database-export service. | Actual template/version, returned export, scope and completeness evidence. Public API authentication description is insufficient to construct routes, payloads or signatures. |
| [OmniStar products](https://www.omnistar.cloud/products) | Spreadsheet migration can create/update supported entities including contacts, applications and projects. | Exact supported import edition and F1's original load/result interface. |
| [Alzheimer's Society transition guidance](https://dementiaconnect.alzheimers.org.uk/what-we-do/researchers/our-application-process/migration-grant-tracker-omnistar) | Historical institution guidance illustrates outline/full continuity and separate account credentials. | Current institution-specific workflow, identity and access decisions. Historical June/August 2026 dates are not a current assignment. |

F1's actual loader remains authoritative. Retain its submitted file, job/request ID, complete result and independent destination return separately. A loader success receipt is not an independent target inventory. Direct warehouse access is an additional vendor offering; it is not presumed.

## One complete intake

Start from the existing source/import and receiving APIs described in CASE_MIGRATION.md and CASE_RECEIVING.md. Keep every original file byte. Select CSV headings or JSON pointers explicitly; a friendly business label never establishes a native vendor field.

Use one scope and identity namespace for the reviewed institution/programme cohort. Within it, each projection may declare:

- **record_family**: explicit family name, such as applications, reviews or payment_requests.
- **identity_scopes**: scopes for mapped case_id, document_id and version_id. For example, {"case_id":"applications"} makes original ID "001" distinct from award "001". The normalized identity is the canonical JSON pair [scope, original ID]. The original field value and the conversion remain retained.
- **columns**: original heading/pointer for every selected identity, lifecycle, relation and comparison field.
- **value_maps**: only explicitly reviewed exact-string replacements. These can align an independently returned foreign key to its retained original key when supported by the actual identity crosswalk; preserve that original crosswalk as evidence.

All source and target occurrences of a family use the same reviewed identity scopes. Scope mismatches become findings. Numeric identifiers are not silently converted to text. JSON numeric tokens remain exact typed lexemes, while CSV text remains text.

### Record and relationship coverage

The grant intake contract accounts for every family below as included or explicitly excluded with a reason. Inclusion does not invent a population.

| Families | Preserve and compare |
| --- | --- |
| persons, organisations | Original identities, organisation links and relevant contact attributes; account activation is separate. |
| programmes, rounds, forms | Programme/round identity, form version, open/close meaning and access rules. |
| applications | Outline/full stage, original parent and form version, status at cutoff, applicant/organisation relationships. |
| reviewers, panels, assignments, conflicts, reviews | Reviewer/panel identities; assignment, COI/NDA decisions; scores and decision meaning. |
| awards, amendments | Award/application link, contract letter/version, amendment chain and original audit evidence. |
| milestones, reports | Schedule, obligations, approval state, original report/award relationships. |
| documents, document_links | Original document/version identity, every association, full returned bytes/hash/size and available metadata/access evidence. |
| payment_requests, payment_approvals, disbursements, refunds | Original amount token, currency, interpretation, state, date meaning and related request/award. Scheduled, milestone, claim, partial, refund and recoup states remain distinct. |
| workflows, access, integrations | Configuration and operational ownership, roles, transitions, interface versions and re-authentication evidence. Copying records does not prove these services work. |

Represent record families as existing **cases**, binary/document inventory as **documents**, and association rows as **links**. This is an internal reviewed projection, not a claim about either vendor's database tables. A case projection requires case_id; document projection requires document_id; links require both.

### Explicit relation rules

Plans accept relation_rules. Each rule has all eight fields:

```json
{
  "id": "application_round",
  "source_family": "applications",
  "field": "round_reference",
  "target_family": "rounds",
  "target_kind": "cases",
  "target_scope": "rounds",
  "cardinality": "one",
  "required": true
}
```

Both families and the relation field must be selected. Every source reference must resolve to exactly one retained original parent. Independently returned references must preserve membership and resolve to a valid target parent at the destination required by that parent's cutoff state. Referenced parents must use the declared scope. Unknown, missing, duplicate, stale or invalid evidence remains a finding.

A many-valued relation requires an **original JSON array in JSONL**. JSON-looking text inside a CSV cell is retained as a typed string and is not automatically decoded. Use the supplier's separate original association export, a documented single-reference row structure, or an explicitly reviewed transformation retained beside the original source. Do not silently split delimiters or parse arbitrary spreadsheet strings.

Document/version references that cannot select one parent version remain ambiguous. Ordinary document links preserve the existing version-aware engine and multi-case copy policy.

## Destination and comparison policy

A grant plan explicitly supplies all four destination_policy fields:

```json
{
  "live_cases": "omnistar_operational",
  "live_documents": "omnistar_documents",
  "closed_cases": "approved_historical",
  "closed_documents": "approved_historical_documents"
}
```

These are operator labels, not vendor endpoints. The actual destination and archive policy need institutional review. Existing plans that omit this extension retain the original dynamics/sharepoint/archive policy.

Lifecycle is selected through exact live_statuses and closed_statuses. Outline-to-full and active-to-historical changes are assessed at each selected cutoff; records with unmapped state, tombstones or unclear authority remain unresolved. A single record cannot be assigned an invented lifecycle. Separate reviewed cohorts/plans where different programmes require different routing.

Use family_checks for explicit per-family comparison fields. These replace the plan's general case/document field list for that family. Select amount token, currency, dates and decisions deliberately. Exact typed comparison does not assert numeric equivalence across formatting differences or perform currency conversion. Preserve a reviewed numeric interpretation as a separate field/evidence edition if needed.

Absence conclusions require matching family **and identity scope**, complete original/target coverage and valid capture times. Complete applications coverage cannot prove absent awards. Filtered, failure-only and unknown populations do not establish deletion or absence. A declared complete return remains the operator's sourced assertion; retain its actual scope evidence.

The original statuses remain MATCH, DIFFERENT, UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS, MISSING and UNEXPECTED. MATCH concerns selected evidence only. It does not mean tenant acceptance, effective authorization or permission to pay.

## Two complete editions

1. Obtain the reviewed source export, actual vendor template, complete relationship/document inventory and exact scope declarations for rehearsal 1. Retain the actual F1 load request/result.
2. Import the independent ID-bearing returned target population. Create explicit projections, the cutoff plan and rehearsal 1. Record findings and their original review histories.
3. Obtain the later source and target editions for rehearsal 2. Create new source occurrences and projections; preserve both original editions and their parent references.
4. Compare the two actual rehearsal IDs. Review changed lifecycle/destination, new records, omitted records and changes in each selected field.
5. Record cutover as hold, ready_for_review or approved under the original engine's evidence requirements. Readiness alone never dispatches a migration. F1 and the institution retain actual release and acceptance authority.

There are exactly two rehearsals in this delivery: the first load/return starts rehearsal 1; reconciliation of it is not an additional rehearsal. Rehearsal 2 uses the later complete editions.

## Complete native receiving command

The original case receiving input is extended by grant_contract:

- schema: commons.grant-migration-contract/v1.
- mode: customer_migration or public_reference_review.
- title, scope_note, source_owner, target_loader, acceptance_owner.
- families: included family → {kind, identity_scope, meaning, compare_fields}.
- excluded_families: each other advertised family → explicit reason.
- interface_evidence: entries with kind, status and description; retained entries name a complete source_files key; missing/not_applicable entries include reason.
- periods: exactly two {label, cutoff_at, plan_key, rehearsal_key}, pointing to actual producer steps.

The native source actions use ordinary result references {"$result":"producer:STEP","pointer":"/id"}. Source/target projections and family checks must be consistent in both periods. The real customer mode requires original customer_export source and independent target imports. Missing template/document/configuration evidence stays explicitly missing; do not replace it with invented files.

```sh
python3 grant_receiving.py --input /absolute/reviewed-input.json --inspect
python3 grant_receiving.py --input /absolute/reviewed-input.json --out /absolute/original-operation
```

This runs the existing ten-phase case programme: original retained intake/history, full reports, complete producer delivery, independent receiver, recipient edit and comparison, older-delivery replay preserving edits, returned delivery, second independent receiver/cold reopen, and exact original request replay. Stable IDs and original request bytes control continuation. The wrapper validates before opening the case, then binds the same bytes in the original receiving journal.

An uncertain/incomplete operation retains its ID. Resume through the original operation control with its explicit reason; do not create replacement IDs or rewrite a completed phase. Preserve the complete old application when an interrupted operation is pinned to it.

## Public-source operator example

```sh
python3 grant_reference_example.py --directory /absolute/owned-grant-reference
```

This authors a source register and thirteen local programme/workflow requirement definitions grounded in the public sources. It records two actual local review editions, an explicit pending reviewer-obligations finding, the corrected local design and a hold decision. It then runs the complete original portable receiving journey and recipient edit.

Every input is marked local_reference/public_reference_review. There are **zero tenant application/award rows, zero vendor loads and zero actual migrated-target results**. The local target register means an operator's design review. It is not an echo represented as independent OmniStar evidence. The second edition is a revised local specification, not a claimed later customer export. The example does not establish delivery acceptance or institutional readiness.

The example preserves its authored source files and original native request history. A successful rerun verifies/reuses the same completed programme. It does not reset the workspace. If interrupted before receiving-input.json is written, exact completed preparation operations replay using their original IDs; an incomplete native preparation stays reserved for original operation.resume with an explicit reason.

## Browser, HTTP and portable compatibility

The existing browser's case projections form exposes record family and identity scopes. Its plan form exposes all four destinations, per-family fields and relation rules. Existing drafts, request IDs, conflict handling, evidence pages, reviews and cutover controls are retained. HTTP and native CLI dispatch the same original actions; no parallel server or importer is introduced.

New portable deliveries include this guide and both grant command modules. Receivers continue accepting the original 16-file workbench and 21-file case application editions. A delivery preparation begun with an older roster preserves that exact complete application. New prepares freeze the whole current roster; source code is never silently mixed across editions.

The complete receiver contains original source objects, SQLite history, immutable case editions, decisions, reports and exact application. Treat customer archives according to their actual access requirements. Public repository source contains generic code and the explicitly public design example only.
