# Register migration workbench

## Complete supplied populations in the existing workspace

The register extension adds explicit person, case, episode, relationship, placement or financial register interpretations to the maintained Migration Workbench. Names and fields are operator choices. It retains the original uploaded bytes, every original source occurrence, complete mapping and all result editions in the same SQLite workspace. It uses the original source import, operation journal, kernel lease, browser server, export generator and portable application.

The existing case/document, grant, financial reporting, source, reconciliation and correction features remain callable. Use the whole current application. The public module and guide are generic; private customer records and commercial correspondence belong in their original private workspaces and cases.

## Source and projection

First import the complete supplied CSV or JSONL through original source.import. Select the original source_inventory or target_inventory role, source scope, identity namespace, capture timestamp, capture kind, declared coverage and scan mode. A CSV import still needs the original canonical column map, for example source_id to the actual original key column. This map satisfies original inventory intake; the new projection reads every complete raw original CSV cell or JSON property.

For register.dataset.create select source_id, a stable flat register name, exact source or target system label, side, explicit field definitions and ordered key_fields. Every identity component is exact text, so "001" differs from "1". Scope and namespace are retained independently of those values. No person linkage, identifier stripping or clinical mapping is inferred.

Each field definition has selector, type and optional required. selector is exactly {column:"original heading"} for CSV or {pointer:"/original/path"} for JSONL. type is text, decimal, date, datetime, boolean or json. required defaults false. Explicit value_maps replace only an exact original string with an operator-selected string or boolean and retain both values.

Text remains exact. Boolean requires an actual boolean or an explicit value map. ISO dates are calendar-validated; datetime requires an explicit offset and normalizes to UTC while retaining the original. Fractional precision beyond six decimal places is accepted only when every additional digit is zero; otherwise the projection is invalid/UNKNOWN, preserving the full supplied lexeme for explicit review. Decimal accepts an exact finite decimal token, up to 1000 coefficient digits and exponent magnitude 1000, preserving sign and avoiding binary floating-point arithmetic. Internal normalized expansions and accumulated sums use a separate exact canonical-decimal parser, so a valid original exponent is not rejected merely because its expanded representation exceeds the original coefficient bound. Decimal totals retain every signed value and perform no currency conversion, rounding or implicit scale change. Structured JSON uses recursive type tags, so an original object cannot impersonate a numeric token.

Missing, null, blank and invalid fields remain distinct. Preview and saved projected rows include complete values, presence, raw typed originals, conversions, issues and source references. Duplicate logical keys retain all occurrences. A corrected interpretation selects parent_dataset_id and creates another immutable dataset. Original source and earlier mappings stay accessible.

## Plans, relationships and independent rehearsals

A plan selects complete source_dataset_ids from one scope and namespace, one exact destination system per register, cutoff_at and max_snapshot_age_seconds. The latter defaults to zero. Each register must have consistent complete canonical field/type/required definitions and ordered identity fields across selected projections.

checks explicitly selects mapped nonidentity fields. When omitted for a register, all mapped nonidentity fields are compared. Both nulls or equal blanks can match only for optional fields; absent or invalid evidence remains unresolved. Different empty strings remain different, even though both are blank. Original typed values stay available.

references select id, register, ordered fields, to_register, complete ordered to_fields, required and cardinality. Each original referring row supplies one scalar text composite identity. A relationship table can represent many explicit edges through its own stable keys. Both one and many retain the declared cardinality, but duplicate referenced logical identities remain ambiguous; this option cannot waive duplicate identities or infer people. Optional references can be absent. A partially supplied composite identity stays unresolved.

The source plan checks the supplied relationships and source evidence. A rehearsal independently selects target_dataset_ids whose register definitions, scope and namespace match the plan and whose system labels equal its declared destinations. Loader success is not a target inventory.

Source captures must be at or before cutoff within the selected age. Target captures must be at or after cutoff. A conclusive missing/unexpected occurrence or relationship requires a usable logical identity, supported referring evidence and independently declared complete/full inventory. Invalid keys, unresolved projection, mismatching row counts, partial/incremental evidence and stale captures remain UNKNOWN for absence claims. Known observed field differences stay visible as their own findings.

Every planned register has an intrinsic kind:control finding with details.type:population, even when both selections contain zero rows and no optional financial controls are configured. Its structurally distinct key ["register_population"] and full dataset/capture/coverage evidence remain visible in plans, rehearsals, comparisons, reports and cutover review. Complete empty source and target populations can match; an omitted, partial, stale or otherwise unresolved population stays UNKNOWN.

Record, reference and control items preserve all original occurrences or complete immutable population selections. Status labels are MATCH, DIFFERENT, UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS, MISSING and UNEXPECTED. Read the actual per-check reasons and evidence together with the overall label.

## Exact signed controls

controls select id, register, decimal measure_fields, nonempty text unit_fields and optional scalar group_fields. Select actual currency/unit fields and meaningful account or period groups from the supplied source contract. Separate measures and distinct units are never silently combined.

The engine streams complete groups from the same SQLite projected rows. Each control retains explicit source/target dataset IDs, group fields and values, row counts, unresolved-row counts, exact observed signed sums and a digest of every complete projected row in deterministic dataset/ordinal order. The immutable dataset readers and exports retain the full constituent rows. A control does not duplicate a large complete register into one table cell.

Complete population comparison is withheld if any selected row has invalid identity, duplicate key, unresolved projection/capture, missing measure or unit/group, or if declared complete/full coverage is unavailable. Rows with unavailable unit/group fields remain in their original null bucket. Their rule-wide unallocated_group_row_counts independently block conclusive comparisons in every known group on that side: a value without a currency cannot certify the GBP subtotal merely by being excluded from it. The observed sums remain labeled observed_sums so operators can inspect supplied values without treating an incomplete subtotal as a certified population total. Each exact measure and the population count have their own check.

## Correction, comparison and cutover review

An immutable successor plan or rehearsal retains its selected predecessor. register.rehearsal.compare requires the same scope, namespace and complete canonical definitions; its complete paged result carries both item bodies and both policies. Entering or leaving a selected result is not a deletion instruction. Changes to source evidence, cutoff, relationships or controls remain explicit.

A review selects one exact rehearsal item, a disposition, full reason and optional original evidence rows. A successor must follow the current unsuperseded review tip. rework, waiting_evidence, accepted_variance and withdrawn remain distinct immutable decisions. A withdrawn acceptance cannot waive a subsequent approval.

A cutover selects the complete rehearsal IDs, hold/ready_for_review/approved, reason, acceptance_owner and current accepted_review_ids. Approval requires every original nonmatching item to have a selected current accepted variance; every such reason and complete original finding is retained. This is an attributed local review. Supplier migration execution and actual customer acceptance use their original contracts and authority.

New reviews and cutovers validate actual current tips while the existing workspace mutex is held through immutable publication. If a previous request already published its exact entity, original same-request recovery adopts it before checking later history. Otherwise an interrupted request cannot publish an approval based on a superseded historical tip.

## Requests, history, pages and full delivery

Use the original /api/operations {operation,payload} and /api/read. Mutations carry operation_id, expected_revision and actor. Exact successful replay precedes current revision checking and returns its original completion revision. Refresh current state before the next new mutation. Resume interrupted operations through original operation.resume with the original handler and payload.

A source-dependent interrupted operation pins this module plus the original source parser, case-value helpers and Store bodies before retaining rows. Complete prefixes are compared byte-for-byte on recovery. Partial rows cannot be read as a completed dataset or result because readers first require its immutable entity.

register.schema advertises the current complete API. register.list, register.dataset.rows, plan.items, rehearsal.items and rehearsal.compare use explicit offset/limit, maximum 500, and return total. Source drilldown uses original row.get and source.get. Complete exports go through the existing locked workspace.iter_export generator and migration_reports.iter_register_export as register.dataset, register.plan, register.rehearsal, register.review and register.cutover, with ndjson or csv. Reports include full descriptors and complete result rows, not only the visible page.

The existing portable pipeline preserves the original SQLite, every source object, full reports, requests and selected application roster. Its new roster must include migration_registers.py, public/migration-registers.js and this guide. Earlier complete editions keep their exact original profile and roster; they are not relabeled as a new application. Re-receiving an identical earlier archive preserves later legitimate customer history.

## Commissioning inputs

An actual customer programme supplies the original private case, exports, fields/identity rules, independent target returns, explicit system labels, time/cutoff evidence, coverage declarations, signed money/unit/period conventions, relationship rules, real reviewer attribution and target execution/acceptance contracts. Public procurement and supplier descriptions inform the operating profile; they do not supply a tenant schema, credentials, actual customer rows or an executable loader contract.

A software example, if run, is labeled as an authored example. Actual receiving must select complete real original inputs, perform the reviewed source-to-target programme, retain two source/target editions where required, reopen reports and portable customer returns, and save its full actual result before claiming completion.

# Register migration operator

## Open the maintained workspace

Start the original Migration Workbench server against the selected private workspace. Use the Register migration section in its existing navigation. File migration, case/document migration, grants, financial reporting and the complete original handover remain available in the same application.

Enter the actual operator name in the masthead. Accepted changes are immutable editions in the existing SQLite workspace. Every operation retains its original request identity, selected revision and actor. The interface uses a neutral industrial layout and the existing full source intake and receiving flow.

## Retain the original inventories

In Sources, retain the entire original file and select inventory_csv or inventory_jsonl. Declare the real scope, identity namespace, capture time and coverage. CSV intake uses its existing minimal canonical mapping; the subsequent register mapping reads the full retained raw original fields. The source row and its original bytes remain available from every projected occurrence.

Use a separate source record for each actual independent target observation. A loader's response and a target's independently observed population have distinct meanings. The original capture context travels into the register dataset and every comparison.

## Map a typed register

Source mappings creates an immutable dataset from one exact source ID. Supply a title, register name, actual system label, source or target side, and a mapping review note. These are operator-selected names and original source mappings.

Add each canonical field with Add mapped field. Enable the selected field, choose its exact CSV heading or RFC6901 JSON pointer, then specify text, decimal, date, datetime, boolean or JSON. Mark required values explicitly. Original values, missing/null/empty distinctions, interpretation issues and explicit conversions stay visible alongside the normalized value.

Identity order selects the logical key. Key fields must be text. Assign distinct positive positions; their ascending order becomes the retained key definition. Preserve source identifier formatting exactly. The tool exposes duplicate logical identities with all original occurrences.

Exact value maps accepts a full JSON object keyed by field and original text. It records explicit conversions without changing the retained source. Preview mapped population reads every original occurrence through complete pagination. Its paging keeps the exact configuration selected when the preview started.

Save complete mapped register creates its immutable dataset edition. An earlier dataset ID records the predecessor. Open original dataset browses the complete retained rows, interpretation findings, original source references and full mapping.

## Define the destination plan

Destination plans selects the full set of original source dataset IDs, an explicit timestamp cutoff, the permitted capture age and a review note.

Target destinations is an ordinary row editor: select each register's exact expected target system. Compared fields lists the mapped nonkey fields to check; leaving it blank selects every mapped nonkey field.

Relationship rules records a rule ID, source register, ordered source fields, referenced register, corresponding ordered referenced fields, required flag and one/many cardinality. The domain evaluates the selected original and independent target populations. Complete coverage and usable identities determine whether a missing reference can be concluded.

Exact unit and group controls records the register, one or more exact decimal measures, explicit text unit fields and optional group fields. Each measure is summed separately for each selected unit/group. Every original signed amount remains exact; the tool performs no implicit currency conversion. Invalid values, unusable identities, partial coverage and stale observations remain attached to the control result.

The full plan preserves every selected dataset and policy. Save a later plan edition to change the mapping, cutoff, destination or control selection while retaining earlier reviews.

## Reconcile and compare

Rehearsals selects one frozen plan and all actual independent target dataset IDs. The complete result includes record comparisons, relationship findings and exact grouped controls. Findings retain MATCH, DIFFERENT, UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS, MISSING or UNEXPECTED with their full supporting checks.

Open complete rehearsal can filter by register, finding kind, status and original identity. Every list is paged against its declared complete count. Inspect sources and complete checks opens the full retained result and its original source row links.

Compare whole rehearsals selects the exact earlier and later IDs and retains both complete original items for each transition. Changed source membership, identities or values remain explicit. Source removal by itself is not a destination deletion instruction.

## Review findings and record cutover

Record decision opens a form bound to the exact rehearsal and finding. Supply a title, disposition, reason and supporting original row IDs. Rework, waiting for evidence, accepted variance and withdrawal remain separate recorded choices. Preparing a successor decision carries the original finding and current predecessor ID into a new draft.

Cutover review selects one or more complete rehearsals in the same source scope/identity namespace, an actual acceptance owner and a recorded decision. Select any current accepted-variance review IDs explicitly. The complete unresolved population, full review basis and original actor remain in the resulting edition. Use the note for actual cutover/recovery instructions and operational continuation.

## Working files and original-request recovery

The register module keeps a complete working file in IndexedDB, scoped to the exact original workspace. It contains unfinished forms, typed mapping rows, target/rule/control editors, selections, original unanswered requests and preserved stopped attempts. The journal compares its previous saved revision so another tab's edits are not silently overwritten.

Form submission captures every selected field and dynamic row before asynchronous persistence or transport. The original request is retained before the existing mutation route runs. A lost return is recovered by inspecting the original operation, retrying the same body/ID, or continuing the same interrupted operation. The original workspace state is refreshed before subsequent revision checks.

Download current working file exports the complete local draft/history. Restore validates its schema and exact workspace, preserves unresolved original requests and merges prior stopped-attempt history. Complete original source bytes and accepted records travel in the ordinary workspace handover.

## Full exports and receiving

Every opened register entity supplies complete NDJSON and CSV downloads. Each begins with the selected full original descriptor, workspace identity/revision and entity identity. Datasets then include every original projected row; plans and rehearsals include every full finding. Reviews and cutovers retain their full original basis. The final CSV column carries the complete original record JSON, including exact decimal values and typed raw values; the display columns escape formula-like text.

The standard complete delivery also contains register-review.html, the five complete register catalogues and full CSV/NDJSON for every retained edition. The HTML joins readable counts and policies with each complete original descriptor and its full row exports. The original SQLite, original file objects, application and all previous workflow results remain in the same package.

Use the maintained Migration Workbench portable receiver to receive into a separate directory, reopen the same workspace and continue its original records. Keep the full register source module, mounted browser module and guide in the portable source roster.

## Source integration

The mounted module is public/migration-registers.js. The existing migration-app.js supplies its ordinary UI helpers, transport, request journal, selected revision and navigation. migration_server.py advertises the additive register read operations and static script. migration_reports.py streams iter_register_export and write_register_reports using the existing workspace mutex, paginated original readers and immutable PublishedText writer.

The domain and native store integration are in migration_registers.py and migration_workspace.py. The register browser does not create an independent business store. Its local working file contains unfinished operator work while accepted records remain in the maintained native workspace.

def ref(key, lane="producer"):
    return {"$result":lane+":"+key, "pointer":"/id"}

def resolve(value, results):
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        if set(value)=={"$result","pointer"}:
            if value["pointer"]!="/id" or not value["$result"].startswith("producer:"):
                raise ValueError("The example selects exact producer result IDs")
            return results[value["$result"].split(":",1)[1]]["id"]
        return {key:resolve(item,results) for key,item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,list):
        return [resolve(item,results) for item in value]
    return value

def run(directory):
    root=ordinary_directory(directory,create=True)
    os.chmod(root,0o700)
    lock=os.open(root/"example.lock",os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
    workspace=None
    runner=None
    try:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    except BaseException:
        os.close(lock)
        raise
    try:
        marker=root/"EXAMPLE.json"
        if not marker.exists():
            publish_bytes(marker,encoded({"schema":"commons.register-migration-authored-example/v1",
                "created_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"meaning":MEANING,
                "identity":"Exact text; 001 and 01 are distinct.",
                "temporal_convention":"Dates are literal values; no interval overlap or endpoint rule is inferred.",
                "finance":"Signed original decimals, currencies and periods; GBP and USD stay separate.",
                "document_meaning":"Authored inventory metadata and versions; external document content is not selected.",
                "access_meaning":"Authored role records; effective target permissions require their own observations."}))
        regular(marker)
        for edition in (1,2):
            folder=ordinary_directory(root/("edition-"+str(edition)),create=True)
            timing=folder/"edition.json"
            if not timing.exists():
                publish_bytes(timing,encoded({"edition":edition,"captured_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                    "meaning":"Publication time of this authored local inventory edition."}))
        input_path=root/"receiving-input.json"
        if not input_path.exists():
            workspace_path=root/"original-workspace"
            workspace=MigrationWorkspace(workspace_path,create=not (workspace_path/"workspace.sqlite3").exists(),
                                         title="Authored register migration example")
            files=[{"key":"example-description","path":str(marker),"filename":marker.name,**file_hash(marker)}]
            steps=[]
            results={}
            first_finding=None
            def apply(key,operation,payload):
                step={"key":key,"operation_id":OPERATION+"-"+key,"operation":operation,"payload":payload,
                      "resume_reason":"Continue this exact retained authored example action."}
                actual=resolve(payload,results)
                request={**actual,"operation_id":step["operation_id"],"actor":ACTOR,
                         "expected_revision":workspace.project["revision"]}
                request_path=root/("request-"+key+".json")
                if request_path.exists():
                    original=json.loads(request_path.read_text())
                    if {k:v for k,v in original.items() if k!="expected_revision"} != {k:v for k,v in request.items() if k!="expected_revision"}:
                        raise ValueError("The authored original action changed")
                    request=original
                publish_bytes(request_path,encoded(request))
                observed=workspace.dispatch("operation.get",{"id":step["operation_id"]})
                if observed["found"] and observed["operation"]["status"]!="SUCCEEDED":
                    resume_path=root/("resume-"+key+".json")
                    control={"operation_id":step["operation_id"]+"-continue", "actor":ACTOR,
                        "expected_revision":workspace.project["revision"],"target_operation_id":step["operation_id"],
                        "reason":step["resume_reason"]}
                    if resume_path.exists():
                        control=json.loads(resume_path.read_text())
                    publish_bytes(resume_path,encoded(control))
                    workspace.dispatch("operation.resume",control)
                returned=workspace.dispatch(operation,request)
                results[key]=returned["result"]
                steps.append(step)
                publish_bytes(root/("accepted-"+key+".json"),encoded({"operation":operation,
                    "operation_id":step["operation_id"],"result":returned["result"]}))
                return returned["result"]
            for edition in (1,2):
                prefix="e"+str(edition)
                folder=root/("edition-"+str(edition))
                captured=json.loads((folder/"edition.json").read_text())["captured_at"]
                selected={"source":[],"target":[]}
                for side in ("source","target"):
                    for family,population in definitions(edition,side).items():
                        key=prefix+"-"+side+"-"+family
                        path=folder/(side+"-"+family+".jsonl")
                        publish_bytes(path,"".join(canonical(row)+"\n" for row in population).encode("utf-8"))
                        files.append({"key":key,"path":str(path),"filename":path.name,**file_hash(path)})
                        staged=_stage(workspace,path)
                        apply(key+"-import","source.import",{
                            "file_sha256":staged["sha256"],"bytes":staged["bytes"],"filename":staged["filename"],
                            "format":"inventory_jsonl","context":{"scope_id":"authored-register-example",
                                "identity_namespace":"authored-records","role":side+"_inventory",
                                "capture_kind":"local_reference","scan_mode":"full","captured_at":captured,
                                "coverage":{"mode":"complete","expected_rows":len(population),
                                    "description":"Complete authored local "+family+" population for edition "+str(edition)+"."},
                                "note":MEANING}})
                        fields={name:{"selector":{"pointer":"/"+name},"type":kind,
                                      "required":not (family=="episodes" and name=="closed")}
                                for name,kind in FIELDS[family].items()}
                        apply(key,"register.dataset.create",{
                            "title":key,"review_note":"Explicit authored source fields; exact text identities and typed values.",
                            "source_id":ref(key+"-import"),"register":family,
                            "system":"authored-origin" if side=="source" else "authored-destination",
                            "side":side,"fields":fields,"key_fields":["id"],
                            **({"parent_dataset_id":ref("e1-"+side+"-"+family)} if edition==2 else {})})
                        selected[side].append(ref(key))
                plan={"title":"Authored edition "+str(edition),"review_note":"Seven complete related authored register populations.",
                    "source_dataset_ids":selected["source"],"cutoff_at":captured,
                    "destinations":{family:"authored-destination" for family in FIELDS},
                    "references":REFERENCES,"controls":CONTROLS,"max_snapshot_age_seconds":0}
                if edition==2:
                    plan["parent_plan_id"]=ref("e1-plan")
                apply(prefix+"-plan","register.plan.create",plan)
                rehearsal={"title":"Authored rehearsal "+str(edition),"review_note":"Independent local authored target inventory.",
                    "plan_id":ref(prefix+"-plan"),"target_dataset_ids":selected["target"]}
                if edition==2:
                    rehearsal["parent_rehearsal_id"]=ref("e1-rehearsal")
                actual_rehearsal=apply(prefix+"-rehearsal","register.rehearsal.create",rehearsal)
                if edition==1:
                    found=workspace.dispatch("register.rehearsal.items",{"id":actual_rehearsal["id"],
                        "kind":"record","register":"finance","status":"DIFFERENT","offset":0,"limit":500})
                    if found["total"]!=1 or len(found["rows"])!=1:
                        raise ValueError("The original authored finance difference is not retained")
                    first_finding=found["rows"][0]
                    evidence=[row["source_row_id"] for row in first_finding["source_rows"]]
                    apply("finding-review","register.review.create",{
                        "title":"Correct the original signed amount","rehearsal_id":ref("e1-rehearsal"),
                        "item_id":first_finding["id"],"disposition":"rework",
                        "reason":"The first target refund differs by 5 GBP; the second authored edition corrects it.",
                        "evidence_row_ids":evidence})
                    apply("first-cutover","register.cutover.create",{
                        "title":"First authored edition review","rehearsal_ids":[ref("e1-rehearsal")],
                        "decision":"hold","reason":"The selected first target retains a refund and workflow-owner difference.",
                        "acceptance_owner":ACTOR})
                else:
                    apply("second-cutover","register.cutover.create",{
                        "title":"Second authored edition review","rehearsal_ids":[ref("e2-rehearsal")],
                        "decision":"approved","reason":"The complete second authored populations and exact selected controls agree.",
                        "acceptance_owner":ACTOR,"parent_cutover_id":ref("first-cutover")})
            if first_finding is None:
                raise ValueError("The original first finding was not selected")
            value={"schema":SCHEMA,"operation_id":OPERATION,"title":"Authored register migration and editable receiving",
                "actor":ACTOR,"authorization":MEANING,
                "workspace":{"path":str(workspace.root),"id":workspace.project["id"],
                             "expected_revision":workspace.project["revision"]},
                "application":[{"path":name,**file_hash(HERE/name)} for name in APPLICATION_FILES],
                "source_files":files,"steps":steps,"delivery_resume_reason":"Continue the exact retained authored delivery.",
                "comparison":{"before_id":ref("e1-rehearsal"),"after_id":ref("e2-rehearsal")},
                "customer_steps":[
                    {"key":"recipient-note","operation_id":OPERATION+"-recipient-note","operation":"workspace.update",
                     "payload":{"title":"Recipient edition of the authored register example",
                                "note":"Recipient independently retained review and cutover continuation."}},
                    {"key":"recipient-review","operation_id":OPERATION+"-recipient-review","operation":"register.review.create",
                     "payload":{"title":"Close the superseded first-edition rework","rehearsal_id":ref("e1-rehearsal"),
                        "item_id":first_finding["id"],"disposition":"withdrawn","parent_review_id":ref("finding-review"),
                        "reason":"The second independent target edition corrects the signed amount; retain the original finding.",
                        "evidence_row_ids":[row["source_row_id"] for row in first_finding["source_rows"]]}},
                    {"key":"recipient-cutover","operation_id":OPERATION+"-recipient-cutover","operation":"register.cutover.create",
                     "payload":{"title":"Recipient second-edition review","rehearsal_ids":[ref("e2-rehearsal")],
                        "decision":"approved","reason":"Recipient reviewed the complete corrected authored edition.",
                        "acceptance_owner":"authored-example-recipient","parent_cutover_id":ref("second-cutover")}},
                ]}
            for step in value["customer_steps"]:
                step["resume_reason"]="Continue this exact retained recipient action."
            publish_bytes(input_path,encoded(value))
            workspace.close()
            workspace=None
        runner=RegisterReceiving.__new__(RegisterReceiving)
        runner.owned=[]
        runner.lock=None
        runner.__init__(input_path,root/"receiving")
        result=runner.run()
        return {"state":result["state"],"operation_id":result["operation_id"],
                "report":str(runner.out/"COMPLETE.json"),"meaning":MEANING}
    finally:
        errors=[]
        if workspace is not None:
            try:workspace.close()
            except BaseException as error:errors.append(error)
        if runner is not None:
            try:runner.close_all()
            except BaseException as error:errors.append(error)
            if not runner.owned and runner.lock is not None:
                fcntl.flock(runner.lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
                os.close(runner.lock)
                runner.lock=None
        # Preserve the native lease when an owned resource cannot close; process exit releases it.
        if not errors:
            fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
            os.close(lock)
        if errors:
            raise errors[0]

def main(argv=None):
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--directory",required=True,help="Private original authored-example directory")
    args=parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(canonical(run(args.directory)))

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

## Full receiving programme

register_receiving.py uses the original maintained Receiving implementation through an explicit register profile. Case and grant receiving retain their original schema, action names and meaning. It runs ten ordered phases:

1. Retain the exact selected original input and complete source files.
2. Execute or replay the supplied original source, typed mapping, plan, rehearsal, review and cutover actions.
3. Produce the complete readable reports and full machine-readable populations.
4. Capture and download the complete original producer delivery.
5. Receive that delivery independently as an editable customer workspace.
6. Apply the customer's actual supplied continuation actions and compare both selected rehearsals completely.
7. Re-receive the original older archive and confirm that later customer edits remain.
8. Prepare the complete customer return, including the original history and source closure.
9. Receive the return independently, read every retained edition and verify both producer and customer operation histories.
10. Replay the exact original requests and confirm the later workspace head remains intact.

The programme owns its original kernel lock and workspace lifetimes, retains full accepted requests before transport, and resumes its original output directory. It does not start child processes or make target-system calls. Source and runtime selection are checked again on each invocation. A completed operation can reopen and verify its original history without replacing later legitimate edits.

Each action has a unique key in its lane, original operation_id, operation and payload. Its optional resume_reason permits the original interrupted action to continue using that retained reason. The original listener port and persistent browser profile survive same-operation continuation. Keep the same source, runtime, input and output directory on retry.

The six complete browser phases exercise the mounted operator: exact source mapping and preview; full working-file download/reopen with its unsent note; seven-register destination/relationship/control plan; independent target reconciliation and two-edition comparison; predecessor evidence-preserving review and attributed cutover; complete CSV/NDJSON/working-file/ZIP downloads; wide and narrow layouts followed by original project reopening. """CRF reporting inside the existing immutable Store, journal and portable receiver."""
from __future__ import annotations
import csv
import hashlib
import io
import json
from collections import Counter
from migration_store import MigrationError, identity, canonical, parse_json, text, digest, identifier, page, basename
from financial_domain import unique_pairs
from property_workspace import file_refs, with_evidence_cache
import crf_domain as domain
import crf_workbook as workbook

KINDS=tuple("crf."+name for name in ("contract","dataset","edition","comparison","review","workbook_binding","workbook_output","workbook_return"))
MUTATIONS=tuple(kind+".create" for kind in KINDS)
READS=("crf.schema","crf.preview","crf.list","crf.get","crf.rows","crf.verify","crf.request_status","crf.workbook_preview")
MAX_SOURCE_BYTES=64*1024*1024
SECTIONS={"crf.contract":(),"crf.dataset":("rows",),"crf.edition":("metrics","checks","lineage"),
          "crf.comparison":("changes","metrics"),"crf.review":("decisions",),"crf.workbook_binding":("cells",),
          "crf.workbook_output":("inputs","workbook_lineage","member_manifest","numeric_precision_warnings"),
          "crf.workbook_return":("inputs","checks","unbound_cell_changes","part_changes","formula_caches","validation_evidence","member_manifest")}
DDL="""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crf_items(
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,section TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT,body_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,section,ordinal));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS crf_items_status ON crf_items(owner_id,section,status,ordinal);"""

def ensure(store):
    store.conn.executescript(DDL)

def schema():
    return {"schema":domain.SCHEMA,"kinds":list(KINDS),"mutations":list(MUTATIONS),"reads":list(READS),
            "fields":domain.FIELDS,"required":domain.REQUIRED,"categories":domain.CATEGORIES,"periods":domain.PERIODS,
            "formats":["csv","json-table"],"maximum_source_bytes":MAX_SOURCE_BYTES,
            "mapping":{"direct":"actual_column","reviewed_translation":{"column":"actual_column","values":[{"source":{"kind":"string","value":"Y"},"target":True}]}},
            "review_dispositions":["open","explained","corrected"],
            "population_contract":"An application row is an explicit awarded/refused/pending reporting unit, including non-application routes. One awarded reporting unit links to one award row; instalments and split spend belong in allocations and payment controls. This is a reviewed reporting mapping, not an assumed vendor API schema.",
            "rule_source":domain.RULES,"workbook_binding_example":workbook.binding_example(),
            "meaning":"Crisis support plus actual supplied other-strand inputs; complete workbook compliance, signatures and DWP receipt remain separate actual events."}

def payload(op,fields):
    p=op["request"]
    domain.require(not set(p)-set(fields)-{"operation_id","actor","expected_revision"},"CRF_REQUEST","Unknown CRF request fields.")
    return p

def base(op,kind,title):
    return {"schema":domain.SCHEMA,"id":kind.replace(".","-")+"-"+identity({"op":op["id"],"sha":op["request_sha256"]})[:40],
            "kind":kind,"title":text(title,"title"),"operation_id":op["id"],"created_at":op["created_at"],
            "created_revision":op["reserved_revision"],"actor":op["actor"]}

def get(store,kind,record_id):
    domain.require(kind in KINDS,"CRF_KIND","Select an advertised retained CRF record.")
    return store.get_entity(kind,record_id)

def records(store,kind,before=None):
    sql,args="SELECT body_json FROM entities WHERE kind=?",[kind]
    if before is not None:sql+=" AND created_revision<?";args.append(before)
    for row in store.conn.execute(sql+" ORDER BY created_revision,id",args):yield parse_json(row[0])

def previous(store,kind,parent_id,scope,op,unique=False):
    matching=[r for r in records(store,kind,op["reserved_revision"]) if all(r.get(k)==v for k,v in scope.items())]
    if parent_id is None:
        domain.require(not unique or not matching,"CRF_PARENT_REQUIRED","Select the current original head instead of forking this decision chain.")
        return None
    old=get(store,kind,parent_id)
    domain.require(old["created_revision"]<op["reserved_revision"] and all(old.get(k)==v for k,v in scope.items()),
                   "CRF_PARENT_SCOPE","The selected parent belongs to this original scope and predates this operation.")
    domain.require(not any(r.get("parent_id")==parent_id for r in records(store,kind,op["reserved_revision"])),
                   "CRF_HEAD","Select the current original head.")
    return old

def descends(store,kind,candidate,original):
    seen=set()
    while candidate:
        if candidate==original:return True
        domain.require(candidate not in seen,"CRF_ANCESTRY","Original ancestry contains a cycle.");seen.add(candidate)
        candidate=get(store,kind,candidate).get("parent_id")
    return False

def rows(store,record_id,section):
    for row in store.conn.execute("SELECT body_json FROM crf_items WHERE owner_id=? AND section=? ORDER BY ordinal",(record_id,section)):
        yield parse_json(row[0])

def read_bytes(store,sha,limit=MAX_SOURCE_BYTES):
    info=store.file_info(digest(sha))
    domain.require(info["bytes"]<=limit,"CRF_SOURCE_SIZE","The complete source exceeds the advertised byte allowance.")
    with store.open_file(sha) as stream:raw=stream.read(limit+1)
    domain.require(len(raw)==info["bytes"],"CRF_FILE_LENGTH","The complete retained source length differs.")
    return info,raw

def reviewed(store,value):
    domain.review(value)
    return file_refs(store,value["evidence_files"],required=True)

def original_source(store,p):
    info,raw=read_bytes(store,p.get("file_sha256"))
    columns,original=domain.original_rows(raw,p.get("format"),p.get("dialect",{}))
    return info,columns,original

def preview(store,p):
    contract=get(store,"crf.contract",p.get("contract_id"))
    domain.require(p.get("family") in domain.FIELDS,"CRF_FAMILY","Select a source family.")
    info,columns,original=original_source(store,p)
    return {"contract_id":contract["id"],"family":p["family"],"sha256":info["sha256"],"bytes":info["bytes"],
            "columns":columns,"row_count":len(original),"sample":[{"raw":r,"raw_types":{k:domain.original_kind(v) for k,v in r.items()}} for r in original[:5]],
            "preview_only":True}

def selected_sources(store,edition):
    return {family:{"dataset":get(store,"crf.dataset",record_id),"rows":list(rows(store,record_id,"rows"))}
            for family,record_id in edition["families"].items()}

def edition_value(store,edition):
    return {**edition["report"],"metrics":list(rows(store,edition["id"],"metrics")),"checks":list(rows(store,edition["id"],"checks"))}

def binding_values(store,binding,edition):
    domain.require(binding["contract_id"]==edition["contract_id"],"CRF_WORKBOOK_SCOPE","Select a workbook binding for this exact reporting contract.")
    metrics={r["id"]:r for r in rows(store,edition["id"],"metrics")}
    values={}
    for key,source in binding["value_sources"].items():
        if "literal" in source:values[key]=source["literal"]
        else:
            item=metrics.get(source["metric_id"])
            domain.require(item is not None and item["status"]=="COMPLETE","CRF_WORKBOOK_METRIC","Select complete original metrics from this exact edition.",metric_id=source["metric_id"])
            values[key]={"type":"number" if item["type"] in ("count","money") else "text","value":str(item["value"])}
    return values

def compute(store,op,emit,*,stage=False):
    kind=op["operation"].removesuffix(".create")
    p=op["request"];body=base(op,kind,p.get("title"))
    if kind=="crf.contract":
        p=payload(op,("title","contract","parent_id"))
        contract=domain.validate_contract(p.get("contract"));evidence=reviewed(store,contract["review"])
        old=previous(store,kind,p.get("parent_id"),{"scope_id":contract["scope_id"]},op,unique=True)
        body.update(contract=contract,contract_sha256=identity(contract),scope_id=contract["scope_id"],
                    parent_id=old["id"] if old else None,evidence_files=evidence)
    elif kind=="crf.dataset":
        p=payload(op,("title","contract_id","family","file_sha256","filename","format","dialect","mapping","context","parent_id"))
        contract=get(store,"crf.contract",p.get("contract_id"));family=p.get("family")
        domain.require(family in domain.FIELDS,"CRF_FAMILY","Select a source family.")
        context=domain.validate_context(p.get("context"));evidence=reviewed(store,context["review"])
        info,columns,original=original_source(store,p)
        mapping=domain.validate_mapping(p.get("mapping"),columns,family)
        normalized=domain.normalize(original,mapping,family)
        old=previous(store,kind,p.get("parent_id"),{"contract_id":contract["id"],"family":family},op)
        for row in normalized:emit("rows",row)
        body.update(contract_id=contract["id"],scope_id=contract["scope_id"],family=family,
                    file_sha256=info["sha256"],bytes=info["bytes"],filename=basename(p.get("filename")),
                    format=p["format"],dialect=p.get("dialect",{}),columns=columns,mapping=mapping,context=context,
                    row_count=len(normalized),issue_count=sum(bool(r["issues"]) for r in normalized),evidence_files=evidence,
                    parent_id=old["id"] if old else None)
    elif kind=="crf.edition":
        p=payload(op,("title","contract_id","period","dataset_ids","note","parent_id"))
        contract=get(store,"crf.contract",p.get("contract_id"));period=p.get("period")
        domain.require(period in domain.PERIODS,"CRF_PERIOD","Select the interim or cumulative annual reporting period.")
        ids=p.get("dataset_ids")
        domain.require(isinstance(ids,list) and len(ids)==len(set(ids)) and len(ids)==len(domain.FIELDS),
                       "CRF_DATASETS","Select exactly one complete retained dataset per source family.")
        selected={}
        for record_id in ids:
            dataset=get(store,"crf.dataset",record_id)
            domain.require(dataset["contract_id"]==contract["id"] and dataset["family"] not in selected,
                           "CRF_DATASET_SCOPE","Select each family once from this exact contract.")
            selected[dataset["family"]]={"dataset":dataset,"rows":list(rows(store,record_id,"rows"))}
        old=previous(store,kind,p.get("parent_id"),{"contract_id":contract["id"],"period":period},op)
        if old:
            for family,item in selected.items():
                domain.require(descends(store,"crf.dataset",item["dataset"]["id"],old["families"][family]),
                               "CRF_DATASET_ANCESTRY","A corrected edition retains each earlier source or its explicit descendant.")
        report=domain.calculate(contract["contract"],period,selected,emit)
        for section in ("metrics","checks"):
            for row in report[section]:emit(section,row)
        report={k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ("metrics","checks","lineage")}
        body.update(contract_id=contract["id"],scope_id=contract["scope_id"],period=period,
                    families={family:item["dataset"]["id"] for family,item in selected.items()},dataset_ids=ids,
                    note=text(p.get("note"),"edition note"),parent_id=old["id"] if old else None,report=report)
    elif kind=="crf.comparison":
        p=payload(op,("title","earlier_id","later_id","note"))
        earlier=get(store,"crf.edition",p.get("earlier_id"));later=get(store,"crf.edition",p.get("later_id"))
        domain.require(earlier["contract_id"]==later["contract_id"],"CRF_COMPARISON_SCOPE","Compare editions of the same original reporting contract.")
        result=domain.compare(edition_value(store,earlier),edition_value(store,later),selected_sources(store,earlier),selected_sources(store,later))
        for section in ("changes","metrics"):
            for row in result[section]:emit(section,row)
        body.update(contract_id=earlier["contract_id"],earlier_id=earlier["id"],later_id=later["id"],
                    earlier_period=earlier["period"],later_period=later["period"],same_reporting_period=earlier["period"]==later["period"],
                    note=text(p.get("note"),"comparison note"),counts=result["counts"],
                    meaning="Full retained source and metric differences. A later annual period is cumulative, not added to the interim totals.")
    elif kind=="crf.review":
        p=payload(op,("title","edition_id","parent_id","decisions_file","review"))
        edition=get(store,"crf.edition",p.get("edition_id"));evidence=reviewed(store,p.get("review"))
        old=previous(store,kind,p.get("parent_id"),{"edition_id":edition["id"]},op,unique=True)
        decision_file=p.get("decisions_file");domain.obj(decision_file,("sha256","filename"))
        decision_info,raw=read_bytes(store,decision_file["sha256"])
        try:
            decisions=json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"),object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs,
                                 parse_constant=lambda value:(_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(value)))
        except (ValueError,UnicodeError) as exc:raise MigrationError("CRF_DECISION_JSON","Use a complete strict JSON decision array.") from exc
        original_checks=list(rows(store,edition["id"],"checks"))
        checks={r["id"]:r for r in original_checks}
        domain.require(len(checks)==len(original_checks),"CRF_FINDING_IDENTITY","The original finding population contains repeated identities; preserve and correct the source edition.")
        seen=set();statuses=Counter();corrections={}
        domain.require(isinstance(decisions,list),"CRF_DECISIONS","Retain the complete decision array.")
        for decision in decisions:
            domain.obj(decision,("check_id","status","note","evidence_files"),("correction_edition_id",))
            key=decision["check_id"]
            domain.require(key in checks and key not in seen,"CRF_DECISION_POPULATION","Each original finding has one explicit decision.");seen.add(key)
            domain.require(decision["status"] in ("open","explained","corrected"),"CRF_DISPOSITION","Select open, explained or corrected.")
            text(decision["note"],"decision note")
            file_refs(store,decision["evidence_files"],required=decision["status"]!="open")
            if decision["status"]=="corrected":
                correction_id=decision.get("correction_edition_id")
                if correction_id not in corrections:
                    corrected=get(store,"crf.edition",correction_id)
                    domain.require(corrected["contract_id"]==edition["contract_id"] and corrected["period"]==edition["period"]
                                   and corrected["id"]!=edition["id"] and descends(store,"crf.edition",corrected["id"],edition["id"]),
                                   "CRF_CORRECTION","Select a complete corrected descendant of this exact period.")
                    corrections[correction_id]={r["id"] for r in rows(store,correction_id,"checks")}
                domain.require(key not in corrections[correction_id],"CRF_CORRECTION_REMAINS","This finding remains in the selected corrected edition.")
            else:domain.require(not decision.get("correction_edition_id"),"CRF_CORRECTION_STATUS","Only corrected findings select a correction edition.")
            statuses[decision["status"]]+=1;emit("decisions",decision)
        domain.require(seen==set(checks),"CRF_REVIEW_POPULATION","Retain one decision for every original finding, including an explicit empty array for no findings.")
        body.update(edition_id=edition["id"],contract_id=edition["contract_id"],parent_id=old["id"] if old else None,
                    review=p["review"],evidence_files=evidence,decisions_file={**decision_file,"bytes":decision_info["bytes"]},
                    decision_count=len(decisions),statuses=dict(statuses),
                    meaning="Explained findings remain unresolved facts. Reviews never convert an incomplete edition into complete workbook inputs.")
    elif kind=="crf.workbook_binding":
        p=payload(op,("title","contract_id","file_sha256","filename","bindings","value_sources","review","parent_id"))
        contract=get(store,"crf.contract",p.get("contract_id"));evidence=reviewed(store,p.get("review"))
        info,raw=read_bytes(store,p.get("file_sha256"))
        bindings=p.get("bindings");sources=p.get("value_sources")
        domain.require(isinstance(bindings,dict) and isinstance(bindings.get("inputs"),list),"CRF_WORKBOOK_BINDING","Use the advertised complete workbook binding.")
        keys=[item.get("key") for item in bindings["inputs"]]
        domain.require(isinstance(sources,dict) and len(keys)==len(set(keys)) and set(sources)==set(keys),
                       "CRF_WORKBOOK_SOURCES","Bind every actual workbook input to one original metric or explicitly reviewed literal.")
        for key,source in sources.items():
            domain.obj(source,(),("metric_id","literal"))
            domain.require(len(source)==1,"CRF_WORKBOOK_SOURCE","Select one original metric or reviewed literal.")
            if "metric_id" in source:text(source["metric_id"],"metric identity")
            else:
                domain.obj(source["literal"],("type",),("value",))
                domain.require(source["literal"]["type"] in ("number","text","boolean","blank"),"CRF_WORKBOOK_LITERAL","Use an explicit typed literal.")
        inspection=workbook.validate_bindings(raw,bindings)["inspection"]
        # Validate typed literal/source contracts without generating a temporary
        # workbook or pretending unresolved metrics have observed numeric values.
        validation_values={}
        for item in bindings["inputs"]:
            source=sources[item["key"]];kind_value=item.get("value_type")
            if "literal" in source:validation_values[item["key"]]=source["literal"]
            else:validation_values[item["key"]]={"type":kind_value,**({} if kind_value=="blank" else {"value":"0" if kind_value=="number" else False if kind_value=="boolean" else ""})}
        workbook.validate_input_values(bindings,validation_values)
        old=previous(store,kind,p.get("parent_id"),{"contract_id":contract["id"]},op)
        cells=inspection.pop("cells",[])
        for cell in cells:emit("cells",cell)
        body.update(contract_id=contract["id"],file_sha256=info["sha256"],bytes=info["bytes"],filename=basename(p.get("filename")),
                    bindings=bindings,value_sources=sources,inspection=inspection,review=p["review"],evidence_files=evidence,
                    parent_id=old["id"] if old else None)
    elif kind=="crf.workbook_output":
        p=payload(op,("title","binding_id","edition_id"))
        binding=get(store,"crf.workbook_binding",p.get("binding_id"));edition=get(store,"crf.edition",p.get("edition_id"))
        domain.require(edition["report"]["status"]=="READY_FOR_WORKBOOK_MAPPING","CRF_EDITION_FINDINGS","Resolve reporting findings through a complete corrected edition before creating workbook inputs.")
        values=binding_values(store,binding,edition)
        _,raw=read_bytes(store,binding["file_sha256"])
        filename="crf-"+edition["period"]+"-"+body["id"][-12:]+"."+binding["bindings"]["format"]
        saved_output=store.get_entity(kind,body["id"],required=False)
        if saved_output is not None:
            # Preserve the actual original ZIP container across supported Python
            # and zlib versions. Verify every expected decompressed member byte
            # without replacing the held file with a freshly compressed archive.
            info,held=read_bytes(store,saved_output["file_sha256"])
            domain.require(info["bytes"]==saved_output["bytes"],"CRF_WORKBOOK_OUTPUT_CHANGED","The original outgoing container length differs.")
            inspection=workbook.verify_population(raw,held,binding["bindings"],values)
            sha,output_bytes=info["sha256"],info["bytes"]
        else:
            domain.require(stage,"CRF_WORKBOOK_OUTPUT_MISSING","The original workbook output record is missing.")
            output,inspection=workbook.populate_template(raw,binding["bindings"],values)
            sha=hashlib.sha256(output).hexdigest();output_bytes=len(output)
            store.stage_file(io.BytesIO(output),filename,expected_sha256=sha,expected_bytes=output_bytes)
        for key,value in values.items():emit("inputs",{"key":key,"value":value,"source":binding["value_sources"][key]})
        for field,section in (("lineage","workbook_lineage"),("member_manifest","member_manifest"),("native_numeric_precision_warnings","numeric_precision_warnings")):
            for item in inspection.pop(field,[]):emit(section,item)
        body.update(contract_id=edition["contract_id"],binding_id=binding["id"],edition_id=edition["id"],
                    file_sha256=sha,bytes=output_bytes,filename=filename,inspection=inspection,values=values,
                    meaning="Actual template-derived inputs. Formula caches have not been recalculated by this application; open in the authorized native spreadsheet operator and return that exact file.")
    elif kind=="crf.workbook_return":
        p=payload(op,("title","output_id","file_sha256","filename","review","observations"))
        output=get(store,"crf.workbook_output",p.get("output_id"));binding=get(store,"crf.workbook_binding",output["binding_id"])
        evidence=reviewed(store,p.get("review"));info,actual=read_bytes(store,p.get("file_sha256"))
        _,original=read_bytes(store,binding["file_sha256"])
        domain.require(isinstance(p.get("observations"),dict),"CRF_RETURN_OBSERVATIONS","Retain actual native operator observations, including actual controls and opened file.")
        inspection=workbook.inspect_return(original,actual,binding["bindings"],output["values"])
        for section in SECTIONS[kind]:
            for item in inspection.pop(section,[]):emit(section,item)
        body.update(contract_id=output["contract_id"],output_id=output["id"],file_sha256=info["sha256"],bytes=info["bytes"],
                    filename=basename(p.get("filename")),inspection=inspection,review=p["review"],evidence_files=evidence,
                    observations=p["observations"],meaning="Actual returned workbook and observed checks; no inferred Section 151 authority, copied submission email, or DWP acceptance.")
    else:raise MigrationError("CRF_OPERATION","Unknown CRF operation.")
    return body

class SectionSink:
    def __init__(self,store,record_id,kind,mode):
        self.store,self.record_id,self.mode=store,record_id,mode
        self.counts=Counter({section:0 for section in SECTIONS[kind]})
        self.hashes={section:hashlib.sha256() for section in SECTIONS[kind]}
    def __call__(self,section,row):
        domain.require(section in self.hashes,"CRF_SECTION_CONTRACT","The computation emitted an undeclared section.")
        index=self.counts[section];encoded=canonical(row)
        self.counts[section]+=1
        self.hashes.setdefault(section,hashlib.sha256()).update((encoded+"\n").encode("utf-8"))
        if self.mode=="write":
            self.store.conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO crf_items VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
                                    (self.record_id,section,index,row.get("status"),encoded))
        actual=self.store.conn.execute("SELECT body_json FROM crf_items WHERE owner_id=? AND section=? AND ordinal=?",
                                       (self.record_id,section,index)).fetchone()
        domain.require(actual is not None and actual[0]==encoded,"CRF_RESULT_CONFLICT","The original complete row differs on continuation or verification.",section=section,ordinal=index)
    def finish(self):
        saved={row["section"]:row["total"] for row in self.store.conn.execute(
            "SELECT section,count(*) AS total FROM crf_items WHERE owner_id=? GROUP BY section",(self.record_id,))}
        domain.require(saved=={section:count for section,count in self.counts.items() if count},"CRF_RESULT_POPULATION","The retained complete section population differs.")
        return {section:{"rows":self.counts[section],"sha256":self.hashes[section].hexdigest()} for section in self.counts}

@with_evidence_cache
def invoke(store,op):
    kind=op["operation"].removesuffix(".create");record_id=kind.replace(".","-")+"-"+identity({"op":op["id"],"sha":op["request_sha256"]})[:40]
    with store.transaction():
        sink=SectionSink(store,record_id,kind,"write")
        body=compute(store,op,sink,stage=True);body["sections"]=sink.finish()
        body["request_sha256"]=op["request_sha256"]
        return store.put_entity(kind,record_id,body,op["reserved_revision"])
